**Job Title:** HR Recruiter (Remote)

​*Alternative search\-friendly titles: Technical Recruiter, Talent Acquisition Associate, Recruiter*

* ​**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent
* ​**Work Location:** Remote (Work from Home)
* ​**Salary:** ₹10,000 to ₹47,000 per month (Base pay \+ performance\-linked incentives)

​**About the Role**

​We are seeking a dynamic, results\-oriented **Remote HR Recruiter** to manage our end\-to\-end talent acquisition lifecycle. In this role, you will act as the bridge between high\-potential talent and our evolving client mandates.

​If you have a sharp eye for identifying top\-tier candidates, thrive in a goal\-driven environment, and want the absolute flexibility of working entirely from home, this is the perfect opportunity to scale your career and maximize your earning potential through our lucrative incentive model.

​**Key Responsibilities**

* ​**Full\-Cycle Recruitment:** Source, screen, interview, and short\-list qualified candidates for various technical, non\-technical, BPO, and corporate roles.
* ​**Smart Sourcing:** Actively leverage job portals (Naukri, Indeed), LinkedIn, professional networks, social media, and internal databases to build a robust candidate pipeline.
* ​**Coordination \& Pipeline Tracking:** Schedule multi\-stage interviews, follow up diligently with both candidates and team leads, and manage real\-time updates across tracking sheets.
* ​**Offer \& Onboarding Support:** Guide selected candidates through document verification, salary negotiations, final job offer acceptances, and initial virtual onboarding.
* ​**Target Achievement:** Meet daily/weekly submission and monthly closure targets to drive team success and unlock peak slabs of your performance bonuses.

​**Requirements \& Qualifications**

* ​**Experience:** 0 to 3 years of experience in recruitment or talent sourcing (consultancy, agency, or corporate BPO recruitment background is highly preferred). *Freshers with exceptional communications are welcome to apply.*
* ​**Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; ability to confidently engage and evaluate mid\-to\-senior level talent over the phone.
* ​**Sourcing Expertise:** Familiarity with boolean search strings, job portal navigation, and candidate screening techniques.
* ​**Remote Setup Prerequisite:** Must possess a reliable laptop/desktop, a dedicated smartphone/headset, and a high\-speed broadband connection with power backup.
* ​**Behavioral Traits:** High emotional intelligence, a strong work ethic, and a self\-motivated approach to daily workflows without needing constant oversight.

​**Perks \& Benefits**

* ​**100% Remote Setup:** Complete freedom to work from the comfort of your own home with no commute friction.
* ​**Uncapped Performance Incentives:** A clear, tiered payout system where top performance easily pushes your monthly take\-home up to ₹47,000\.
* ​**Career Growth:** Direct visibility into diversified hiring models, fast\-track promotions to senior recruitment tiers, and hands\-on exposure to leadership roles.
* ​**Work\-Life Balance:** Structured day shifts with fixed weekend routines.

​**Indeed Optimization Tips for Posting:**

* ​**Keep the Title Clean:** Avoid emojis or fluff like *"Hiring Urgently!! RockStar Recruiter"* in the actual Indeed title field. Keep it exactly as **HR Recruiter** or **Technical Recruiter**, and select the "Remote" checkbox during setup.
* ​**Select the Exact Salary Range:** When entering the salary component on Indeed, use the "Range" option and select ₹10,000 as the minimum and ₹47,000 as the maximum per month. Specify that this includes commission/incentives in the supplemental pay checkboxes.

description:
**Job Description – IT Executive**

**Position:** IT Executive  
**Department:** Information Technology  
**Reporting To:** Sr. Executive – IT  
**Location:** Thane \- HO

**Role Overview**

The IT Executive will be responsible for providing technical support and ensuring the smooth functioning of the organization's IT infrastructure. The role includes troubleshooting technical issues, maintaining networks and systems, managing software and hardware installations, and supporting end\-users across the organization. The position plays a critical role in minimizing downtime and ensuring uninterrupted delivery of services and business operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide first\-level technical support to employees and resolve hardware, software, network, and system\-related issues.
* Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other peripheral devices.
* Assist in the setup, maintenance, and troubleshooting of LAN, Wi\-Fi, internet connectivity, and network devices.
* Manage installation, configuration, and updates of operating systems and software applications.
* Maintain IT asset inventory and ensure proper documentation of hardware and software resources.
* Create and manage user accounts, email IDs, and access rights as per company policies.
* Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for equipment maintenance and support.
* Monitor system performance and perform routine preventive maintenance.
* Ensure timely backup of critical data and support data recovery activities when required.
* Assist in implementing and maintaining information security practices and IT policies.
* Support employees in using Microsoft Office applications and other business systems effectively.
* Maintain records of IT support requests and resolutions.
* Escalate unresolved issues to the Sr. Executive – IT and assist in implementing corrective actions.
* Provide support during onboarding and offboarding of employees, including device allocation and account setup/deactivation.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies and recommend improvements to enhance IT efficiency.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, or a related discipline.
* Diploma or certification in IT, Networking, or Hardware Management will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Internship or project experience in IT support, networking, or system administration will be preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Windows operating systems and Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* Familiarity with computer hardware, printers, and networking concepts.
* Understanding of LAN/WAN, Wi\-Fi, internet connectivity, and troubleshooting techniques.
* Basic knowledge of antivirus software and data backup processes.
* Exposure to remote desktop tools and helpdesk support systems will be an advantage.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
* Good organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
* Customer\-oriented approach with a proactive attitude.

title: Teacher- Digital Skills
description:
Akanksha is on a mission to build one of the largest and most innovative networks of schools in India, serving children from low\-income communities, to maximize their potential. Our aspirational vision for students integrates academic excellence with life skills (including socio\- emotional development), that will enable each child to live an empowered life. We believe an empowered citizen must possess a sense of mastery to pursue excellence, a sense of agency to make informed choices and a sense of purpose to serve their communities. Over the last 30 years, Akanksha has been at the forefront of proving what’s possible for children from low\-income communities in Mumbai \& Pune. Our 5,100 alumni are on the path to living an empowered life. Today Akanksha runs 26 schools in partnership with governments of Mumbai, Pune, Pimpri\-Chinchwad, Navi Mumbai and Nagpur serving \~14,000 children in grades Jr Kg \- Gr 10\.

**Position: Computer Teacher**

**Function/Team:** Akanksha

**School Location:** Dadar (Mumbai)

**Compensation:** Based on skill sets, experience and sector standards

**Reports to:** School Leader

**Position Summary:**

As an Akanksha teacher, you will be directly responsible for at least 40 kids in a class. Your role will be to guide the students toward academic achievement while inculcating self\-esteem and values in their curriculum that will empower them to think critically and make informed choices in their lives. You will cultivate an environment of high achievement coupled with fun learning in the classrooms. You will build strong bonds with children to understand each child’s needs and work with parents as partners in their child’s education and future. You will work with grades 3\-10 to implement our digital skills and computer science curriculum.

**Overview of the Team:**

The Akanksha Schools aim to be high\-quality schools serving children from low\-income communities in Mumbai . These schools work in partnership with local municipalities, with the vision of creating small clusters of model schools in these cities that can be used to impact the mainstream education system. The School Team comprises teachers, social workers, school administrator and helpers led by the School Leader.

**What your role will entail:**

● Teaching the Akanksha curriculum through effective pedagogical practices

● Designing and executing lesson plans that will engage students

● Designing assessments that thoughtfully evaluate student progress

● Varying teaching strategies and styles to meet different learning needs

● Providing a positive environment to engage students in the learning process

● Establishing and maintaining a co\-operative working relationships with students, parents, community and the school team

● Clearly articulating high expectations for students

● Creating and maintaining an aesthetically positive environment

● Actively participating in network opportunities for professional development

● Attending and participating in all school training and meetings

● Meeting professional obligations through efficient work habits

● Actively participating in all extra\-curricular and celebratory activities in school

● Making occasional community visits to stay connected with parents

● Observe other team members to learn more about the school culture, classroom management, content and skill execution

● Working collaboratively with the Digital Learning Core Team at Akanksha

● Coordinating with the School/IT team to set up and manage the required device infrastructure at the school

● Supporting schools and teachers to integrate digital skills in other subjects.

What you need for this Position

**Experience**

● Candidates with prior education/certification/experience in computer science / IT can apply

● Past teaching experience is preferred but freshers also encouraged to apply

**Education**

● BCS, MCS, BCA, MCA, B.Sc./MSc. in CS, B.Tech/MTech in CS are preferred.

● Graduates from other streams may also be considered provided with relevant experience in computer science / IT.

● B.Ed. preferred (not mandatory)

* Knowledge for Python ,C\+\+,Java and any other coding language good to have.

**Knowledge/Skills:**

● Strong content knowledge and expertise

● Love for children and learning

● Adaptability to new instructional approaches

● Patience and capacity to solve problems

● Good planning and organizing skills

● Strong team player

● Self\-motivated with strong work ethics to achieve school goals

● Openness to feedback and critical reflection

● Strong oral and written communication skills in English

● Sharp knowledge and understanding of computer science and digital skills

title: System Administrator
description:
**Job Title:** 
 System Administrator
 



**Job Location:** 
 Bopal, Ahmedabad
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  
 



**About the Company:** 




  
 



 OMSGuru is a 8\-year\-old software product company located in Bopal, Ahmedabad working in the eCommerce Industry. OMS Guru is a backbone for online eCommerce vendors and helps them grow their businesses profitably. We serve over 10000\+ happy clients who use our services. OMSGuru is built with single goal in mind: to help big \& small sellers and retailers manage their back\-end business operations with ease. Thank you for your interest in OMS Guru solutions private limited.
 



  
 



**Job Summary:** 




 We are seeking a skilled and experienced System Administrator to manage, maintain, and optimize our physical and virtual IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in server administration (Windows, Linux, and MacOS), networking, virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V/Proxmox), cloud (AWS), automation tools, security, and application hosting. You will be responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, and security of systems and services across multiple platforms.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Install, configure, maintain, and monitor physical and virtual servers, desktops, and laptops.
* Manage network devices including firewalls, switches, routers, and GSM gateways.
* Configure and troubleshoot firewall, TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VPNs, and routing policies.
* Implement and manage backup/restore solutions for VMs, databases, and applications.
* Manage virtualized environments (
 **VMware ESXi 8** 
 , Proxmox, Hyper\-V).
* Administer NAS/SAN storage and RAID configurations.
* Deploy and monitor web applications on IIS, Apache, and Nginx servers.
* Install and manage databases (MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL).
* Handle patch management and system updates for servers and network devices.
* Manage and integrate VoIP/SIP solutions with Asterisk servers.
* Monitor infrastructure using ELK Stack, Zabbix, NewRelic, Grafana with Slack/email alerts.
* Support Office 365 and Google Workspace users and policies.
* Maintain and secure GitLab server, version control, and source code access.
* Manage endpoint security via ESET Security Server.
* Troubleshooting software and hardware issues (desktops, laptops, servers).
* Configure and secure remote access using RDP, SSH, Telnet, SNMP.
* Deploy and maintain open\-source applications on Linux servers.
* Implement automation and integrations using Bash, PowerShell, Zapier, and n8n.
* Maintain inventory, licensing, and documentation for IT assets.
* Communicate with vendors and service providers for technical support.
* Ensure secure handling of passwords, API keys, and secrets using 2FA and encryption.



  
 



**Required Skills and Experience:** 



* **System Administration** 
 : Windows (2–5 years), Linux (2–5 years), MacOS
* **Networking** 
 : TCP/IP, VPNs, Routing, Firewall configuration, DNS, DHCP
* **Storage/Backup** 
 : SAN, RAID, NAS, disaster recovery, patching
* **Virtualization** 
 : VMware ESXi 8, Hyper\-V, Proxmox (2–3 years)
* **Cloud Platforms** 
 : AWS (EC2, S3, Route 53\)
* **Security** 
 : Endpoint protection, 2FA, patch management, network protocols
* **Databases** 
 : MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL
* **Monitoring** 
 : Zabbix, ELK, Grafana, NewRelic
* **Scripting** 
 : Bash, PowerShell (basic to intermediate level)
* **Automation Tools** 
 : Zapier, n8n
* **Communication** 
 : Work with vendors, document processes, team collaboration



  
 



  
 



**Qualification:** 



* **Education** 
 : B.E./B. Tech/BSc in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics \& Communication
* **Certifications (Preferred)** 
 : RHCE, MCSA/MCSE, VMware, AWS, ITIL, CEH, or similar



  
 



**Additional Information:** 



* Availability for 24x7 on\-call support as per requirement
* Must maintain confidentiality and security best practices at all times



  
 



**How to Apply:** 




 Please send your resume on hr@omsguru.com

description:

 As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be an approachable, proficient communicator who is fundamentally interested in taking ownership in resolving issues, while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction is maintained and delivered. * Problem reporting, customer concern, replication, and resolution management
* Respond to customer technical inquiries
* Site visits and conference calls with customers and partners.
* Developing \& refining internal processes to improve support efficiency and productivity

* B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software engineering, or Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience

* Automation \- Ansible

* Analysis and diagnosis of highly complicated networking problems
* Good communication and presentation/oral skills
* Excellent verbal and written English skills
* Tenacious, with good follow\-up, and attention to detail


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Knowledge of Linux/Unix (Administration level)
* Ethernet (10/40 GigE) and/or Infiniband
* Clustering or data center technologies including Upper Layer Protocols (i.e., MPI)
* Strong interpersonal communication skills and ability to prioritize/multitask easily with limited supervision

 The Artificial Intelligence Engineer will work full time on\-site in Gautam Buddha Nagar, collaborating with designers, developers, and product stakeholders to build intelligent features into Wormos’s web and digital solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include researching, designing, and implementing machine learning models, optimizing algorithms for performance, and integrating AI components into production\-level software. The role involves applying pattern recognition and neural network techniques to improve user experience, personalization, and automation in client\-facing applications. The engineer will also evaluate new AI frameworks and tools, document technical approaches, and contribute to best practices for scalable and maintainable AI systems.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong foundation in Computer Science and Software Development, including data structures, algorithms, and version control.
* Experience with Pattern Recognition and Neural Networks for real\-world applications such as classification, prediction, and recommendation systems.
* Hands\-on expertise in Natural Language Processing (NLP), including text analysis, conversational interfaces, and language models.
* Proficiency with programming languages commonly used in AI (such as Python or JavaScript) and relevant AI/ML libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn).
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work collaboratively on\-site, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and translate business needs into AI solutions.
* Experience deploying AI models into production environments and optimizing for scalability and performance is a plus.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, and MLOps practices for model monitoring and continuous improvement is beneficial.

title: Intern
description:
**We’re hiring at Pitney Bowes, where top talent builds meaningful careers and lasting impact. We Move fast, Deliver excellence, and Win together…that’s The Pitney Bowes way. Here, how we work matters just as much as what we achieve.**


We’re looking for people who:

* Act with urgency, accountability, and purpose
* Deliver high quality work with consistency and pride
* Collaborate effectively and elevate those around them
* Focus on outcomes that drive impact and growth

**Job Description:**


Join Pitney Bowes as an Intern


Years of Experience: Fresher


Role – Contractual(Third Party Vendor)


Work model – Hybrid(3 days office visit)


Job Location\- Noida

**Impact**


As Intern(Automation), you will be part of the team that designs and develops cloud\-based offerings. You will be deeply involved in leading the validation of the SaaS based offering including collaborating across the organization with Architects, UX experts, product managers and other software developers. You will use your expertise in building automation test framework to do sanity of the product.


**The Job**

* Design, create and maintain automated test cases and determine priority for the test cases and create execution plans to implement these scenarios.
* Maintain automated regression suites/packages to be compliant with changing requirements and features.
* The candidate should be able to work independently to identify test cases/test scripts from requirements and map test cases/scripts back to the original requirement
* Understand business objectives and build alignment and buy\-in cross\-functionally.  

Analyze functional and technical requirements and translate them into manual and/or automatable scenarios.
* Developing and Executing testing automation for Cross Browser (browsers like Safari, Chrome, Mobile browsers) and android tablet
* Participate in Agile working practices such as daily scrum meetings, sprint planning meetings, reviews, and retrospectives.

**Qualifications \& Skills required**

* Experience in Android application development
* Exposure to IOT domain
* Good understanding of fundamental design principles behind a scalable application.  

Understanding of the HTTP2\.0 protocol, web applications, performance and monitoring.
* Understanding of the differences between multiple delivery platforms, such as mobile vs desktop, and optimizing output to match the specific platform
* Knowledge of user authentication and authorization between multiple systems OAuth2\.0
* Proficient understanding of Gitlab, CI/CD, DevOps practices
* Knowledge in network architecture \& server administration
* Having the knowledge of front\-end technologies like Angular 16\+ and NodeJS is a plus.
* Great attention to details and Organizational skills

**Education**

* Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or relevant field
* or emergencies.

**The Team**

**Pitney Bowes** (NYSE: PBI) is a global shipping and mailing company that provides technology, logistics, and financial services to more than 90 percent of the Fortune 500\. Small business, retail, enterprise, and government clients around the world rely on Pitney Bowes to remove the complexity of sending mail and parcels. For additional information visit Pitney Bowes at www.pitneybowes.com.

**We will:**

* Provide the will: opportunity to grow and develop your career
* Offer an inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
* Deliver challenging and unique opportunities to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
* Offer comprehensive benefits globally **(****PB Benefits and Wellbeing Programs**)


Pitney Bowes is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusiveness in the workplace.  

  

All interested individuals must apply online.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
The Relationship Manager is responsible for converting consultations into treatment plans while delivering an exceptional patient experience. The role involves understanding patient concerns, educating them about suitable treatments, handling objections ethically, closing sales, and ensuring continuous follow\-up for long\-term patient relationships. The counsellor works closely with doctors and therapists to deliver seamless patient care while achieving revenue targets.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Consultation

* Welcome every patient professionally and build trust.
* Understand the patient’s concerns, expectations, and treatment goals.
* Explain treatment plans, expected outcomes, timelines, pricing, and payment options.
* Present Gleuhr’s treatment philosophy and USPs confidently.
* Recommend appropriate packages and skincare products based on the doctor’s diagnosis.

Sales \& Revenue

* Achieve monthly revenue and conversion targets.
* Convert consultations into treatment packages.
* Upsell add\-on services and skincare products wherever appropriate.
* Handle objections professionally without aggressive selling.
* Maximize treatment acceptance while maintaining ethical practices.

Follow\-up \& Retention

* Conduct timely follow\-up calls and WhatsApp messages.
* Reconnect with consultation\-only, product\-only, single\-session, and inactive patients.
* Ensure every patient remains engaged until treatment completion.
* Generate repeat business and referrals through excellent service.

CRM \& Documentation

* Update CRM after every consultation.
* Maintain accurate consultation notes and follow\-up schedules.
* Record quotations, treatment plans, and patient interactions.
* Ensure zero missed follow\-ups.

Patient Experience

* Deliver a premium, empathetic, and personalized consultation.
* Coordinate smoothly with doctors, therapists, and reception.
* Resolve patient concerns promptly.
* Maintain complete confidentiality and professionalism.

Required Skills

* Excellent communication and persuasion skills.
* Strong objection handling and negotiation ability.
* Relationship\-building and empathy.
* Sales closing capability.
* Basic CRM and computer knowledge.
* Professional grooming and presentation.
* Ability to work under revenue targets.

Preferred Experience

* 1–5 years in aesthetic, dermatology, cosmetic, wellness, healthcare, luxury retail, hospitality, insurance, or premium sales.
* Freshers with excellent communication and sales aptitude may also be considered.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Consultation\-to\-sale conversion %
* Revenue achievement
* Average billing value
* Product attachment rate
* Follow\-up compliance
* Repeat patient ratio
* Patient satisfaction score
* CRM accuracy
* Attendance and SOP adherence

What Gleuhr Offers

* Attractive fixed salary with uncapped incentives.
* Structured training and certification.
* Clear career progression to Senior Counsellor/RM → Team Leader → Branch Manager → Regional Sales Manager.
* Continuous coaching and performance\-based growth.
* Opportunity to work with one of India’s fastest\-growing premium skin clinics.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Business Development Executive
description:
**Job Title: Business Development Executive**

**Location:** Sector 83, Mohali

**Position:** Business Development Executive  
**Experience:** 1 to 3 Years

**About Us:** 

Offshore Marketers is a data\-driven digital marketing agency focused on delivering performance\-oriented solutions across SEO, paid ads, funnels, and automation. We are currently seeking a **Business Developer** with the experience of 1 to 3 Years who can bridge business needs with technical execution, helping us scale smarter and drive growth using insights, systems, and strategy.

**Role Overview:**

As a Business Developer, you will work closely with cross\-functional teams—including marketing, sales, and tech—to identify business opportunities, optimize workflows, and support data\-driven decision\-making. This role is ideal for someone who understands digital marketing ecosystems and wants to contribute strategically to business and product development.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Business Requirement Gathering:** Work with stakeholders to collect, define, and translate business needs into functional requirements and project documentation.
* **Lead Funnel Analysis:** Analyze lead generation funnels and user journeys to identify bottlenecks, conversion drop\-offs, and opportunities for optimization using tools like Google Analytics, Hotjar, and CRM dashboards.
* **Lead Generation \& Revenue Contribution:** Strategically identify and utilize various online portals to generate qualified leads, nurture opportunities, and contribute directly to the company’s revenue pipeline.
* **Client Needs Mapping:** Conduct discovery calls and align client objectives with internal capabilities, translating business goals into measurable KPIs and performance metrics.
* **Market \& Competitive Intelligence:** Perform competitor benchmarking, trend forecasting, and audience segmentation using research platforms and data visualization tools.
* **Proposal \& SOW Documentation:** Create business proposals, technical documentation, and scope of work documents using a structured, data\-backed approach.
* **CRM \& Data Management:** Maintain data integrity within CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho), generate reports, and build dashboards to track business development performance.
* **Process Automation Support:** Identify areas for workflow automation using tools like Zapier, Make (Integromat), or CRM\-native automation features.
* **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** Act as the liaison between business, marketing, and technical teams to ensure the successful implementation of growth and campaign strategies.

**Technical \& Core Skills Required:**

* **Basic Analytical Tools:** Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets for reporting and simple data analysis (e.g., filters, charts, basic formulas).
* **CRM Familiarity:** Hands\-on experience or basic understanding of any CRM platform like Zoho, HubSpot, or GoHighLevel to manage leads and track client interactions.
* **Digital Marketing Awareness:** General understanding of how online funnels, paid ads, and email campaigns work. Experience working with teams using tools like MailerLite, Meta Ads Manager, or Systeme.io is a plus.
* **Documentation Skills:** Ability to create structured documents such as client briefs, simple reports, and workflow outlines using MS Word, Google Docs, or Notion.
* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills for coordinating with team members and presenting findings or suggestions clearly.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to identify issues, think critically, and suggest practical solutions based on available data.
* **Organizational Tools:** Comfortable using basic project management tools like Trello, ClickUp, or Google Calendar to manage tasks and timelines.

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher

Pay: From ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Steward/Hostess - Magnolia Bakery (NYC)
description:
**Job Summary**

As a Team Member, you will play a crucial role in delivering an outstanding customer experience. From product knowledge to ensuring quick and friendly service, you will be the backbone of store operations. This role requires energy, teamwork, and a passion for great service.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1\. Product Knowledge**

* Carries good product knowledge and should be able to explain all products to customers.
* Maintain consistency in serving size, right packing and smallware use.
* To adhere to strict food safety, hygiene and grooming standards.
* Cupcake icing knowledge is a must for all team members.

**2\. Customer Service \& Order Fulfilment**

* Greet customers warmly and take orders efficiently.
* Ensure order accuracy and timely service.
* Handle customer inquiries and feedback professionally

**3\. Store Operations \& Maintenance**

* Maintain cleanliness in the dining, and workstation areas.
* Assist in stocking inventory and managing supplies.
* Follow all safety and sanitation protocols.
* Follow the opening/closing checklist, wastage sheet daily.
* Paying attention to every aspect of service\- from cleanliness to presentation.
* Responsible to maintain all smallware and equipment’s.

**4\. Teamwork \& Efficiency**

* Work collaboratively with the team to ensure smooth operations.
* Assist colleagues during peak hours to maintain speed of service.
* Follow instructions from managers and supervisors effectively.
* To carry out any job assigned by the Supervisor/Outlet manager
* Each team member is expected to maintain a low ego, understanding that we all play a vital role in preserving and expanding our brand.

**5\. Adaptability**

* Be flexible in handling multiple tasks as per operational needs.
* Willing to adjust to changes in work schedules, customer flow, and outlet requirements.
* Open to learning new processes and supporting different roles when required.
* Maintain a positive attitude in dynamic or challenging situations.

**6\. Attention to Detail**

* Follow recipes, SOPs, and quality standards with accuracy.
* Ensure correct portion sizes, presentation, and packaging at all times.
* Double\-check customer orders before serving to avoid errors.
* Keep workstations organized and monitor expiry labels, storage, and cleanliness.

**7\. Basic Financial Awareness**

* Ensure accurate billing and handle cash/card transactions responsibly.
* Follow company guidelines on discounts, offers, and complimentary items.
* Be mindful of minimizing wastage and using resources efficiently.
* Report any discrepancies in cash, billing, or inventory to supervisors promptly

**Core Competencies Required**

* Strong communication skills
* Teamwork and leadership mindset
* Attention to detail
* Customer\-focused attitude
* Basic financial awareness
* Operational discipline
* Problem\-solving ability

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹240,000\.00 \- ₹288,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

 We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented

**experience**

 The ideal candidate should be able to take ownership of the complete design journey — from understanding product requirements and user needs to creating intuitive web and mobile experiences. You will work closely with product managers, stakeholders, and developers to ensure the final product is visually polished, user\-friendly, and aligned with the intended design vision.

**End\-to\-End Design Ownership**

* Design intuitive and responsive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.
* Follow platform guidelines such as Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design.
* Create adaptive layouts for mobile phones, tablets, and different screen sizes.
* Maintain usability, visual consistency, and accessibility across platforms.

* Design UI systems, screens, and reusable components using Figma or Adobe XD.

* Design micro\-interactions and motion concepts where required.
* Use tools such as Figma Advanced Prototyping, Framer, or similar platforms to validate design ideas.
* Present design concepts clearly to stakeholders and internal teams.


**Developer Collaboration**
* Prepare clear design specifications, assets, and handoff documentation for developers.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams to reduce implementation gaps.
* Support developers during the build phase by clarifying design behavior, spacing, responsiveness, and interaction details.
* Ensure the final product matches the intended design vision.

**Technical Awareness**

* Understanding of responsive design principles.

This is the Global Shared Services arm of General Mills Inc., which supports its operations worldwide. With over 1,300 employees in Mumbai, the center has capabilities in the areas of Supply Chain, Finance, HR, Digital and Technology, Sales Capabilities, Consumer Insights, ITQ (R\&D \& Quality), and Enterprise Business Services. Learning and capacity\-building is a key ingredient of our success.
Job Description:  

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one other and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.  

**OVERVIEW**

  

The “Insights and Analytics” organization within General Mills’ Strategy and Growth function is responsible for delivering integrated consumer, customer, category, and business performance insights to power smarter, faster decisions and next\-best actions, enabling precision in brand strategies, campaign execution, media and investment optimization across our US businesses and brands. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices, and this role is in our Strategic \& Commercial Insights team. **Purpose of the role**
Lead the India\-based team for Future \& External Insights organization, with primary accountability for advancing **competitive intelligence for North America Retail**, as well as, coaching and elevating the output for your team.
The **Future \& External Insights(FEI)** team, within the Strategic \& Commercial Insights org in I\&A, builds the understanding, conviction, and empathy that helps General Mills' business partners make bolder, more consumer\-centric decisions. This team sits at the intersection of people, culture, and the marketplace — tracking who consumers are and what drives them, what culture is producing and where it's heading, and what competitors and the external environment are signaling about where things are going next.
This role is at the intersection of future\-facing insight, business acumen, and influential storytelling, making meaning from many inputs and translating it into actions teams can take. In addition, this role is designed to strengthen day\-to\-day deliverables through mentorship and coaching of the India FEI talent and ensure the team’s work reflects an integrated lens across **consumer, culture, and competition**. **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

 **Oversee recurring competitive and adjacent deliverables of the team, and coach and elevate the India\-based FEI team (40%)*** Oversee and improve recurring outputs that help stakeholders mine current competitive activity more effectively, including work such as **Hotlist, Peer Pulse, Customer Pulse**, and related competitive monitoring activities.
* Ensure deliverables have strong strategic framing, clear takeaways, and consistent quality.
* Coach team members responsible for recurring publications while raising the standard for speed, relevance, and storytelling.
* Help each team member sharpen their analytical thinking, storytelling, synthesis, and business relevance.
* Guide the team towards stronger integration across recurring and ad hoc deliverables so that the output is not siloed by a topic.

**Lead competitive intelligence for the FEI org (30%)*** Own the competitive intelligence agenda for FEI organization, ensuring the team is consistently surfacing what competitors are doing, why it matters, and what it means for General Mills.
* Develop a clear point of view on competitive moves across brands, categories, channels, innovation, messaging, partnerships, and capability shifts.
* Directly own competitive inspiration as an individual leadership deliverable for the role. Curate best\-in\-class examples, emerging plays, and provocative case studies that inspire brand and insight teams to think differently.
* Bring an external lens that helps the organization learn not only from direct competitors, but also from adjacent categories, insurgent brands, and culturally relevant operators.
* Translate fragmented signals into crisp, actionable stories and implications for business partners and internal stakeholders.
* Identify where near\-term competitor activity connects to broader marketplace, consumer, and cultural shifts.

 **Integrate culture into competition (15%)*** Guide work that sits at the intersection of **culture and competition**, recognizing that some outputs may formally sit under cultural workstreams while still bringing the competitive environment to life.
* Specifically, help shape efforts like the **Hotlist** so they are leveraged not only as cultural readouts, but as culturally relevant views into competitive change.
* Ensure the team consistently connects marketplace activity to broader cultural momentum, rather than treating these as separate lenses.


**Build an integrated way of working across consumer, culture, and competition (15%)*** Reinforce a team model where **consumer, culture, and competition** are threads running through all major workstreams rather than standalone silos.
* Encourage collaboration across initiative owners so the team’s work feels connected, cumulative, and sharper in implication.
* Partner closely with FEI Leader and other stakeholders to ensure the team’s remit is delivered in a way that is both specialized and highly collaborative.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE*** The organization has stronger access to **competitive inspiration** that helps teams see what is changing and how to respond.
* The team consistently reflects an integrated lens across **consumer, culture, and competition**.
* The India team is better coached, better connected, and able to operate with less day\-to\-day oversight while maintaining high standards.
* Competitive intelligence is more proactive, sharper in implication, and more tightly connected to business action.
* Recurring deliverables such as Hotlist, Peer Pulse, and related monitoring outputs are elevated in clarity, integration, and strategic value.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* **8\-9 years** in consumer insights, strategy, brand/marketing strategy, trend/cultural intelligence, competitive intelligence
* **9\+ years** of consumer insights experience in an agency or with a client working on in strategy, brand/marketing strategy, trend/cultural intelligence, competitive intelligence

 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Education – Master’s degree or MBA with specialization in Market research or Marketing
* Comfort with multiple data sources (quantitative, qualitative, cultural, behavioral, Euromonitor, social, Nielsen RMS, Panel, and internal tools) and integrating them seamlessly
* Must have strong experience in **competitive intelligence, strategic insights, or external insights**
* **Signal translation**: Demonstrates identifying meaningful shifts (consumer/cultural/marketplace) and turning them into implications, decisions, or partner direction
* Proven ability to **lead and coach teams**, especially in a matrixed or cross\-geography model
* Excellent synthesis and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn disparate signals into clear business implications
* Strong judgment in connecting competitive, cultural, and consumer signals
* Ability to balance **hands\-on delivery** with **team leadership**
* Comfort working across recurring reporting, strategic synthesis, and inspiration\-oriented work
* Must have strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with diverse stakeholders and team members globally

title: Manager, Operations COE, West Zone
description:
Designation:


Location: India Maharashtra H002\-Pantaloons West Zone


Organization: Fashion \& Retail

**Job Description:**
--------------------

#### **Job Purpose**


To drive operational excellence across all stores in the West Zone through strong governance, compliance, audit readiness, process standardisation, and execution of strategic projects. The role partners closely with Store Operations, Projects, IT, Supply Chain, HR, and Business Teams to ensure store readiness, superior customer experience, omni\-channel efficiency, and adherence to SOPs, thereby enabling profitable and smooth store functioning.

**Key Accountabilities**

  

Supporting Actions

  

NSO (New Store Opening) – Compliance, Inventory \& Launch Readiness

  

* Lead operational readiness for new store launches, ensuring complete compliance with SOPs, statutory requirements, and inventory controls.
* Coordinate with Projects, VM, IT, Supply Chain, Finance, and Store Operations to ensure seamless launch execution.
* Validate NSO checklists, ensure merchandising and inventory accuracy, and drive zero?error opening readiness.
* Highlight gaps in pre?opening audits and drive timely closure of action points.
  

Audits – SOP, Safety \& In?Store Service Standards

  

* Ensure 100% adherence to store SOPs, statutory norms, safety protocols, and operational processes.
* Conduct periodic audits and store readiness reviews to assess compliance in cashiering, commercial processes, stock management, backstore discipline, VM, and customer service.
* Drive corrective action plans for audit findings and monitor their zone?wide closure.
* Strengthen compliance culture by conducting refresher trainings and reinforcing SOP discipline.
  

Special Projects – RFID \& Express Checkout

  

* Drive successful implementation of RFID?based inventory processes and Express Checkout initiatives across the zone.
* Ensure adoption of tools, accurate tagging, scanning discipline, and resolution of exceptions.
* Support project rollouts by providing field insights, monitoring pilot outcomes, and ensuring adherence to rollout timelines.
  

Omni Operations, MRTO \& Customer Complaints

  

* Drive omni?channel execution quality across the zone, ensuring store readiness for pick?ups, deliveries, order fulfilment, and inventory accuracy.
* Monitor MRTO performance, identify bottlenecks, and work with stores to reduce turnaround time.
* Liaise with Customer Service teams to track complaint trends and drive corrective measures for service recovery and process improvements.
  

Aurify Requirements \& Store Compliance Monitoring

  

* Ensure all Aurify platform requirements are met by stores, including timely submissions, validations, and dashboard updates.
* Track store\-level compliance metrics and drive adherence through routine follow\-ups, reviews, and escalation management.
* Support store teams in closing non\-compliances and improving audit and compliance scores.
  

Data Sufficiency – MH, GC

  

* Ensure data sufficiency and accuracy for Mystery Shopping (MH) and Guest Connect (GC) metrics.
* Monitor score trends at store, cluster, and zone level, and work with store teams to improve gaps in service behaviours and customer experience.
* Drive initiatives to enhance NPS, service excellence, and in\-store experience outcomes.
  

Awaaz Query SPOC

  

* Serve as the Zonal SPOC for all Awaaz platform queries and grievances.
* Ensure timely resolution of tickets through strong follow\-ups with stores, HR, and other stakeholders.
* Track escalations and ensure closure within defined SLAs.
  

EOSS Readiness – Zonal SPOC

  

* Lead operational preparedness for EOSS (End of Season Sale) across the zone.
* Coordinate with Retail Ops, Merchandising, VM, and Supply Chain to ensure smooth execution.
* Monitor readiness parameters such as manpower planning, stock deployment, signage, ticketing, customer service counters, and queue management.
* Drive daily EOSS reviews and ensure corrective actions for smooth store operations during peak periods.
  

People Management

  

* Build operational capability across stores through continuous coaching, on\-ground visits, and strong governance practices.
* Identify training needs and strengthen frontline capability on SOPs, cashiering, inventory management, Omni workflows, and customer service.
* Ensure stores have the right operational bench strength and succession readiness.
* Create a culture of accountability, discipline, and high performance.
* Plan and execute all Ops?related training sessions for Store Managers, Department Managers, and store teams.
* Conduct periodic refreshers on safety, SOPs, shrinkage control, customer service, RFID usage, Express Checkout, and Omni workflows.
* Partner with HR and L\&D for capability\-building programs and continuous skill enhancement.

title: Systems Integration Advisor
description:
**Req ID:** 376076
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.

We are looking for a strong Senior Full Stack .NET Developer with 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have deep expertise in the .NET ecosystem, strong front\-end development skills with TypeScript, and experience building robust, high\-performing, and secure enterprise applications. * Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and efficient code following best practices
* Optimize application performance, scalability, and security
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues effectively
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture decisions
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to team capability building

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**  

* 8\+ years of experience in software development with strong full stack expertise
* Strong experience with C\#, ASP.NET Core, .NET Framework / .NET Core / .NET 6\+
* Solid experience in building Web APIs, MVC applications, and microservices
* Strong front\-end development experience with TypeScript
* Experience with modern front\-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or similar
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and responsive design
* Experience with SQL Server and strong knowledge of database design, queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning
* Familiarity with Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core
* Experience with Git and modern version control practices
* Good understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, and object\-oriented programming
* Experience with unit testing and integration testing frameworks
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized deployments
* Familiarity with message queues such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or AWS Service Bus
* Exposure to authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth2, JWT, OpenID Connect
* Knowledge of NoSQL databases is a plus
* Experience in domain\-driven design and event\-driven architecture is an advantage

* Full stack architecture and solution design
* Strong ownership and accountability
* Ability to work independently and in team environments
* Excellent debugging and performance optimization skills
* Strong mentoring and leadership capabilities
* Focus on quality, scalability, and maintainability


**Sample Tech Stack:**  

* Backend: C\#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core
* Frontend: TypeScript, Angular/React, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
* Database: SQL Server
* Tools: Git, DevOps, Docker
* Cloud: AWS


**Education:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field preferred

description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
* Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counselling employees and supervisors.
* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

title: Senior Manager Talent Acquisition
description:
**Build our future together:**



Reporting to the Director Talent Acquisition, the Senior Talent Acquisition Manager will be responsible for full life cycle recruiting for assigned Corporate Business groups in India. They will also assist with the execution of TA strategy through effective recruitment strategy and crafting solutions to improve processes. The individual must have strong recruiting and sourcing activities as well as people management and organizational skills. The individual exercises good judgment in a variety of situations, has strong written and verbal communication and an ability to balance multiple priorities.


**When \& where:** Hyderabad


**Discover your role:**


* Identifies and attracts top talent across international markets by allocating time and resources to focus on top priorities, utilizing data\-driven decisions, and taking ownership for successful outcomes.
* Acts as a strategic advisor to leaders by devising and deploying diverse talent strategies.
* Lead recruiting for assigned corporate roles by developing a dynamic sourcing approach.
* Ensures Regeneron Talent Acquisition practices are in line with company overall cultural philosophy, generating a inclusive pipeline of candidates.
* Partners with strategic search firms where needed to ensure roles are filled in a timely manner.
* Partners with the talent brand team to develop market appropriate strategies to attract the right talent to Regeneron at the right time in a culturally sensitive way.
* Partners with TA Operations and HR Technology to ensure Regeneron has fit for purpose Applicant Tracking, CRM, Sourcing systems etc.
* Deliver great candidate and hiring team journeys by using data to optimize our process and approach.
* Partners closely with HRBPs, HR COEs and Business Leadership to assess talent needs and hire remarkable employees. Understand Regeneron’s workforce planning activities and uses insights to prepare for future Talent Acquisition activities.
* Provides hiring and employment data, metrics, and visualization analytics to help support talent acquisition decision making.
* Maintains awareness of government regulations, employment and privacy law and engages with Company Counsel as needed.
* May manage a team, ensuring Regeneron has the right resources as we scale up talent acquisition activities.

title: SAP PI/PO and ABAP Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Join Kyndryl as an Application Consultant and become a catalyst for innovation and transformation. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of driving change and enabling our customers to harness the power of technology to achieve their wildest ambitions. From revolutionizing healthcare to shaping the future of finance, you'll collaborate with a diverse range of industries, tailoring cutting\-edge solutions to meet each customer's unique needs.  

  



**Key Responsibilities**

**SAP ABAP Development**

* Design, develop, and optimize custom programs using **ABAP (Reports, ALV, Interfaces, Enhancements, Forms)**
* Develop and enhance **BDC, BAPI, RFC, BADI, User\-Exits, Enhancement Framework**
* Build and maintain **SmartForms, Adobe Forms, and SAP Scripts**
* Work on **Data Dictionary objects** (Tables, Views, Indexes, Domains, Data Elements)
* Performance optimization using **SQL tuning, runtime analysis, and debugging techniques**

**SAP PI/PO Integration**

* Design and implement **end\-to\-end integration scenarios** using SAP PI/PO
* Build and configure:
	+ **Integration flows (iFlows)**
	+ **Message mappings, Interface mappings, Operation mappings**
	+ **Communication channels and adapters (SOAP, REST, IDoc, RFC, File, JDBC)**
* Monitor and troubleshoot interfaces using **Message Monitoring, Component Monitoring**
* Handle **error handling, reprocessing, and performance tuning of interfaces**

**System Integration \& Interface Development**

* Develop **IDoc, RFC, Proxy\-based interfaces**
* Integrate SAP with **3rd party systems (cloud, legacy, APIs)**
* Work with **EDI interfaces and middleware communication**
* Ensure data consistency and secure message exchange

**Support \& Maintenance**

* Provide **L2/L3 production support**
* Analyze and resolve incidents, defects, and performance issues
* Perform **root cause analysis** and implement preventive fixes
* Work on **change requests and enhancements**

**Collaboration \& Delivery**

* Collaborate with **functional consultants (FI, MM, SD, HR, etc.)**
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Participate in **Agile/Scrum delivery models**
* Prepare technical documentation and unit test cases

Your Future at Kyndryl
  

As an Application Consultant at Kyndryl you will join the Kyndryl Consultant Profession, working with other Kyndryl Consultants, Architects, Project Managers, and cross\-functional Technical Subject Matter Experts – presenting unlimited opportunities with unmatched support through our investment in your learning, training, and career growth.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Strong expertise in:
	+ SAP ABAP (RICEF objects)
	+ SAP PI/PO 7\.4/7\.5
* Good knowledge of:
	+ Web Services (SOAP/REST)
	+ XML, XSLT, JSON
	+ SAP NetWeaver architecture
* Experience with:
	+ IDoc, ALE, Proxy, RFC interfaces
	+ SAP HANA (preferred: CDS views, AMDP basics)

Tools \& Technologies


* SAP GUI, SE80, SE38, SE11
* SAP PI/PO Integration Builder, ESR, ID
Transport Management (CTS)  
* 

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science / IT / Engineering
* SAP certifications (ABAP, PI/PO) are an advantage
* Experience in S/4HANA migration or integration projects
* Exposure to SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) is a plus

Soft Skills


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work independently and in cross\-functional teams
* Adaptability to fast\-paced project environments

Experience Level


* 8\+ years of experience in SAP ABAP with hands\-on experience in PI/PO integration projects

Nice\-to\-Have


* Experience in API management / SAP Integration Suite
* Knowledge of Fiori/UI5 basics
Exposure to DevOps tools and CI/CD in SAP  
* 

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Insurance Operations Analyst, Forms Audit
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

The Forms Quality Auditor is an individual contributor on Rippling’s Insurance Forms team responsible for ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of all forms mapping work completed by ICs. This role is the quality gate of the team — owning end\-to\-end audit workflows, identifying patterns in defects, and driving measurable improvement in output quality.

  

Beyond auditing, this role is expected to be a process innovator: identifying workflow inefficiencies, building lightweight tracking frameworks in Google Sheets, and proposing scalable process improvements that reduce rework and improve turnaround times. The ideal candidate combines a sharp eye for detail with an ownership mindset, and is equally comfortable reviewing field\-level form configurations and presenting quality metrics to leadership.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Audit forms completed by the team for relevant insurance lines to ensure data is accurate and meets provider rules.
* Check forms before they are submitted to make sure data is pulled correctly and the data formats match requirements.
* Use a standard scoring system to review work fairly and track quality over time.
* Identify, log, and resolve forms issues quickly to minimize downtime and recurring inefficiencies.
* Manage the team’s metrics dashboard (in Google Sheets) to track error rates, response times, and overall volume.
* Find the root cause of issues and turn those findings into clear actionables for the team.
* Suggest and test new ideas to make the review process faster and reduce mistakes.
* Collate all findings and keep team SOPs up\-to\-date.
* Give clear feedback to team members and work with managers to help coach those who need it.
* Be the go\-to expert for tricky questions about forms, rules, and system logic.
* Work with Product and Engineering to flag system bugs using clearly detailed Jiras.
* Talk to partners, brokers, and internal teams to resolve any external form or data issues.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Experience: 3\+ years in insurance operations, benefits administration, or forms management; ideally at an insurance carrier, TPA, broker, or HR tech company.
* Auditing Background: Proven experience in QA or auditing operational/technical work, with a track record of improving quality scores or reducing error rates.
* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of US insurance forms (enrollment, EOI, life events) across medical, dental, vision, life, and disability lines.
* Technical Logic: Solid grasp of form\-mapping logic; knowing how backend data fields populate forms and how to troubleshoot data breaks.
* Data \& Tools:
* Intermediate Google Sheets (formulas, pivot tables, building dashboards).
* Adobe Acrobat (creating and managing fillable PDFs and field configurations).
* Jira \& Salesforce (managing cases and tracking system bugs).
* Soft Skills: Exceptional attention to detail, clear communication with both technical teams and external carriers/brokers, and a knack for solving and not just flagging problems.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience building QA frameworks, audit scorecards, or SLA reporting processes.
* Background in SaaS, HR tech, or insurance\-tech environments.
* Familiarity with benefits administration platforms or carrier portals.
* Experience mentoring junior operations team members.

Supporting nearly 400,000 team members across stores, distribution centers and headquarters, HR serves as a strategic partner to leaders and team members alike. Our diverse community of people professionals works behind the scenes to cultivate a progressive culture of respect, reward, growth and opportunity.


Within Human Resources, Talent Acquisition plays a critical role in shaping Target’s future workforce. Recruiters lead the candidate journey end to end—from first engagement through onboarding and beyond—while acting as ambassadors for the Target employer brand. We tell a compelling story of what it truly means to work at Target and why it remains a destination employer in a competitive market.

**Role Overview**  

As a Senior Recruiter, you will design and execute talent acquisition strategies that attract, assess and hire top talent across assigned client groups. You will serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders and HR partners, leveraging market insights, data and relationships to deliver hiring outcomes aligned with business priorities. This role requires a balance of strategic thinking, operational excellence and candidate\-centric execution, while continuously enhancing Target’s reputation as an employer of choice.

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Lead full\-cycle recruitment for complex and critical roles, from intake through offer acceptance.
* Develop and execute proactive sourcing strategies using digital platforms, professional networks, referrals and direct outreach.
* Build and maintain strong pipelines of diverse, high\-caliber talent for current and future needs.
* Partner closely with hiring leaders and HR partners to understand business objectives, identify talent gaps and recommend staffing solutions.

* Act as a brand ambassador by authentically representing Target’s culture, values and career opportunities.
* Participate in external networking and professional organizations to strengthen market presence and talent connections.
* Lead or contribute to special projects that enhance recruiting capabilities, processes and innovation.

Office**Job Description**

**About Thermo Fisher:**

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, growing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life\-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an outstanding combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry\-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD. For more information, please visit www.thermofisher.com.


Position summary


We are looking for a highly capable Sales Compensation Analyst to support the end\-to\-end administration of sales incentive compensation for our EMEA sales organization. This role is responsible for accurate and timely compensation cycle execution, strong data controls, clear stakeholder coordination, and continuous improvement of compensation processes, tools, and reporting. The role suits a detail\-oriented analyst who can work confidently with large data sets, sensitive employee information, and tight payment timelines while partnering closely with Sales, HR, Finance, and Sales Operations colleagues.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and deliver core activities in the quarterly sales compensation cycle, including data validation, calculation support, payment processing, reconciliation, and issue resolution.
* Ensure compensation data is complete, accurate, auditable, and handled in line with confidentiality and control requirements.
* Validate accrual inputs and partner with Finance and the broader Sales Operations team to improve accrual accuracy and process discipline.
* Investigate commission queries, resolve issues within agreed timelines, and identify root\-cause fixes that reduce repeat exceptions.
* Support the design, implementation, communication, and ongoing administration of sales incentive plans across EMEA.
* Act as a key user for Xactly Incent and help drive system adoption, process standardization, and enhancement opportunities.
* Prepare analysis and reporting that help stakeholders understand payment outcomes, exceptions, trends, and operational risks.
* Create and maintain process documentation, training materials, and knowledge\-transfer content to strengthen team resilience and consistency.
* Partner effectively with HR, Finance, Sales, and other operations teams on changes, projects, and business priorities related to incentive compensation.
* Contribute to process improvement and automation initiatives that improve cycle efficiency, control quality, and user experience.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 3 to 4 Years of Experience with relevant skillset
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to work confidently with large and complex data sets.
* Experience in sales compensation, incentives, finance operations, sales operations analytics, or another analytically rigorous operational environment.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver high\-quality work to tight deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to validate, manipulate, and analyze data accurately and efficiently.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
* A process improvement mindset with the discipline to work effectively in a controlled environment.
* Comfort working with confidential employee and payment\-related data.
* Flexible to work in Shifts.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Xactly Incent or another incentive compensation platform.
* Knowledge of common sales incentive concepts, plan mechanics, and compensation governance practices.
* Experience with Cognos or similar reporting / data warehouse tools such as Redshift, SQL language.
* Exposure to training, process documentation, or knowledge\-transfer activities within an operations team.

**Success in the first 12 months:**

* Compensation cycles are delivered accurately and on time, with strong control discipline and minimal rework.
* Stakeholder queries are resolved faster and recurring issues are reduced through better process fixes.
* Accrual inputs and compensation reporting become more reliable and easier for partners to interpret.
* Xactly usage, documentation quality, and operational consistency improve across the team.

**Why this Role matters:**


This role sits at the heart of a commercially important process. Accurate incentive compensation supports seller trust, financial accuracy, and business credibility. The person in this role will help ensure that compensation operations are executed with precision while improving the underlying process and systems over time.


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.


At Thermo Fisher Scientific, each one of our 100,000 extraordinary minds has a unique story to tell. Join us and contribute to our singular mission—enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Apply today http://jobs.thermofisher.com. Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.
