title: (IND) Benefits Consultant
description:
Dayforce is a global human capital management (HCM) company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and Minneapolis, Minnesota, with operations across North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa (EMEA), and the Asia Pacific Japan (APJ) region.
  
Our award\-winning Cloud HCM platform offers a unified solution database and continuous calculation engine, driving efficiency, productivity and compliance for the global workforce.
  
Our brand promise \- Makes Work Life Better™\- Reflects our commitment to employees, customers, partners and communities globally.
  
  

**Job Summary:**  

The Benefit Consultant is a crucial role in our organization and a subject matter expert for the Dayforce HCM Benefits module and Managed Benefits offering. As a Benefit Consultant, you will provide in\-depth analysis and recommend solutions to business problems. You will triage complex inquiries and issues from internal and external partners, leveraging technical and analytical skills to provide solutions.
  
  

Individual Responsibilities
  
**Triage Inquiries \& Provide Solutions:** Triage complex inquiries and issues from internal and external partners, leveraging technical and analytical skills to provide solutions via our CRM tool as outlined by our team’s guidelines.
  
**Audits:** Comparing and Analyzing Data sets using V\-Lookups and ad\-hoc reporting skills.
  
**Customer Meetings and Health:** Assess customer health using our team’s defined process to ensure we mitigate any risk to our business. Lead client facing calls with agendas and action logs.
  
**Subject Matter Expert:** This role is a subject matter expert for the Dayforce HCM Benefits module and Managed Benefits offering and provides in\-depth analysis and recommends solutions to business problems.
  
**Benefit Recalculations:** Perform benefit recalculations and analyze recalculation results to ensure there are no issues.
  
**Configuration:** Understand and explain systems features and benefit plan setups. Identify issues related to benefits, taking a global approach by recognizing issues and researching all other customers to determine if they are also impacted.
  
**Testing:** Test changes to plan configuration and release items impacting benefits throughout the year and during Open Enrollment.
  
**File Monitoring:** Ensure benefit exports are successfully transmitted from Dayforce to the customers Carriers. Research and resolve failed files.
  
**Project Oversight:** Provide project oversight for Open Enrollment projects, ensuring all deliverables are completed and Managed Benefits best practice and standards are consistently met. Coordinate with other internal teams to drive resolutions.
  
**Carrier Communications \& File Tasks:** Coordinate with benefit carriers during Open Enrollment to understand their file requirements. Efficiently complete all necessary file\-related tasks, ensuring uninterrupted coverage for our customers employees.
  
**Process Improvements:** Participate in process improvement projects and recommend product enhancements that will benefit our customers or the Managed support model.
  
**Customer Satisfaction:** Maintain the highest level of customer satisfaction through a detailed understanding of the customers business needs and business practices.
  
  

Qualifications
  
**Experience:** 5\+ years in US benefits is required.
  
**Education:** A high school diploma or GED is required. A bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, or equivalent experience is desired.
  
**Skills:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational skills, attention to detail, time management skills, strong customer focus, analytical and problem\-solving abilities, and the ability to work individually and in a team environment.
  
**Knowledge:** Proficiency in auditing large data sets, organizing data, and summarizing findings. Ability to recognize complex problems, analyze situations, and provide suggested resolution.
  
  

What’s in it for you
  
Dayforce is fueled by the diversity of our talented employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider and embrace ALL individuals and what makes them unique. We believe our employees should be happy and healthy, with peace of mind and a sense of fulfillment.
  
We encourage individuals to apply based on their passions.
  
Dayforce encourages personal and professional growth. We offer excellent time away from work programs, comprehensive wellness initiatives and recognition through competitive pay and benefits.
  
With a commitment to community impact, including volunteer days and our charity, Dayforce Cares we provide opportunities for you to thrive both in your career and personal life. Our focus is not just on your job but on supporting you to be the best version of yourself.
  
Artificial intelligence may be used in the screening, assessment, or selection of applicants for this position.
  
Fraudulent Recruiting
  
Beware of fraudulent recruiting. Legitimate Dayforce contacts will use an @dayforce.com email address. We do not request money, checks, equipment orders, or sensitive personal data during the recruitment process. If you have been asked for any of the above, or believe you have been contacted by someone posing as a Dayforce employee, please refer to our fraudulent recruiting statement found here: https://www.dayforce.com/be\-aware\-of\-recruiting\-fraud
  
Dayforce actively monitors all job applications to ensure authenticity. Submissions determined to be fraudulent or misleading will be declined from the recruitment process
company_description: Dayforce is a global human capital management technology company serving over 25 million users in more than 50 countries.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. **Job Summary**


We are seeking a skilled **Accounting Analyst** to join **India Analytics CoE** \-**Global Finance Services Division.**

The Incumbent would perform staff accounting functions that support business processes and gain experience with Caterpillar accounting practices.


The preference for this role is to be based out of **Whitefield Office, Bangalore, India**

**What you will do**

* From the outset, incumbent will be expected to be a contributing performer, doing staff level accounting work that supports business processes.

**Additionally, this position will:**

* Gain an understanding of Caterpillar’s business and accounting practices, systems, and procedures.
* Learn and develop skills which result from the practical application of basic accounting knowledge, and
* Aid a project team or others in the work group.


Accountants will be exposed to a variety of accounting functions and will accomplish a high level of compilation and basic analysis work, reviewing clerical input and generating reports. The accountant identifies relevant data and data sources, gathers, and analyses the information, and provides feedback. Typically, decisions will impact relatively medium to high risk issues and will be reviewed by a supervisor. A supervisor will direct work, but this position does not require close supervision to be effective.


Possible areas of responsibility are varied, including:

* Cost system maintenance
* Abnormals identification \& reporting
* Prime product and/or component cost monitoring \& analysis
* Operations and/or product group budgeting and expense analysis
* Standard and current cost grief resolution
* Support management with analysis for decision making in various projects and cost reduction programs
* NPI support including future cost, should cost, alternative analyses and strategy
* Enterprise coordination and/or governance of costing activities
* Product group and/or operational strategy development \& execution
* Low\-cost producer analysis
* Post implementation audit (PIA) completion
* Development of new/alternative costing methodologies, processes, and/or systems
* The variety of accounting tasks ranges from low to medium complexity. Interaction outside the workgroup is typically with peers. As the Accountant gains experience, he/she will develop a technical understanding of more complex accounting issues and expand their decision\-making capability.
* Accountants will continuously learn through training and experience. Learning at this level will focus on methods, processes and systems applied to accounting, developing communications skills and building

**What you will have**

* Requires a fresher who is CA or CMA semi\-qualified, or an accounting graduate with 2–3 years of relevant experience—preferably within a manufacturing environment.
* Good accounting background, thorough knowledge of accounting flow and related methods of recording in the General Ledger and knowledge in SAP environment (FI, MM \& CO Module).
* Effective communications skills and a good understanding of computer systems especially in MS\-Office and Financial Analytics Tool (Power BI, Tableau, Power Apps. etc.).
* Must demonstrate strong leadership, initiative, inter\-personal skills, and ability to communicate effectively.

**Skills desired:**

 **Accuracy and Attention to Detail**: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.  

Level Extensive Experience:  

* Evaluates and makes contributions to best practices.
* Processes large quantities of detailed information with high levels of accuracy.
* Productively balances speed and accuracy.
* Employs techniques for motivating personnel to meet or exceed accuracy goals.
* Implements a variety of cross\-checking approaches and mechanisms.
* Demonstrates expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards.

  

**Analytical Thinking:** Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.  

Level Extensive Experience:  

* Seeks discrepancies and inconsistencies in available information; explains variances.
* Organizes and prioritizes the sequence of steps to be taken to remedy the situation.
* Identifies many possible causes for a problem based on prior experience and current research.
* Quantifies the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success before recommending a course of action.
* Approaches a complex problem by breaking it down into its component parts.
* Chooses among a diverse set of analytical tools according to the nature of the situation.

  

**Decision Making and Critical Thinking**: Knowledge of the decision\-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.  

Level Working Knowledge:  

* Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision\-making process.
* Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
* Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
* Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
* Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

  

**Effective Communications**: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.  

Level Working Knowledge:  

* Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
* Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
* Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
* Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
* Looks for and considers non\-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

* Career developments opportunities with global prospects

* Employee mental wellness assistance program

* Employee investment plan
* Pay for performance \-Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers


This position requires working onsite five days a week.
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.**Posting Dates:**

title: Junior IT Security Analyst (GRC)
description:
**Job Overview**

Fourth Command is looking for a Junior IT Security Analyst (GRC) to join its team in a full\-time role focused on governance, risk, and compliance activities. This position is ideal for a fresher or early\-career candidate who wants to build a career in cybersecurity with practical exposure to GRC platform management, risk assessment, standards mapping, workflow support, API integration coordination, and security documentation.

The selected candidate will support day\-to\-day GRC operations by helping manage platform activities, organizing compliance and risk\-related information, assisting in workflow configuration, supporting documentation, and working with internal stakeholders on security and governance requirements. GRC roles commonly act as the bridge between business processes and security requirements by helping organizations manage risk, maintain compliance, and improve governance practices.

This role is best suited for someone who has a strong interest in cybersecurity governance, attention to detail, and the willingness to learn how security standards, policies, controls, and technology platforms work together in an organizational environment. The role also requires a basic technical mindset, including familiarity with coding concepts and support for platform\-related integrations and process automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the day\-to\-day management and administration of GRC platforms, including maintaining records, updating entries, supporting modules, and helping users navigate platform\-related tasks.
* Assist in conducting risk assessments by identifying risks, documenting observations, tracking remediation items, and supporting the preparation of risk registers and related reports.
* Help map security controls, policies, and internal processes against applicable cybersecurity standards and frameworks.
* Support the documentation and maintenance of major global cybersecurity standards and compliance requirements relevant to the organization, such as:
* ISO/IEC 27001
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF)
* SOC 2
* PCI DSS
* GDPR
* HIPAA
* CIS Controls
* Assist with API integration\-related coordination for GRC or related platforms by supporting technical discussions, documenting integration requirements, validating data flow expectations, and working with technical teams where needed.
* Support workflow creation, updates, testing, and monitoring within the platform to improve process efficiency and task tracking.
* Provide platform support to internal users by helping troubleshoot basic issues, following up on platform tasks, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day usage.
* Prepare, maintain, and organize GRC\-related documentation, including policies, procedures, process notes, evidence records, user guides, control documentation, and audit support material.
* Assist with audit and assessment readiness activities by organizing evidence, maintaining repositories, and supporting follow\-up actions on observations and findings.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure risks, controls, workflow requirements, and documentation needs are properly tracked and updated.
* Support ongoing improvement of governance and compliance processes through structured reporting, documentation quality, and process discipline.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Fresher candidates can apply.
* Bachelor’s degree required in:
* BSc (IT)
* BSc (Cyber Security)
* BSc (Computer Science)
* BCA
* Candidate must have a minimum academic qualification of above 7\.0 CGPA in their qualifying degree.
* Good understanding or academic exposure to cybersecurity, information security, governance, risk, or compliance concepts is preferred.
* Basic awareness of major global cybersecurity standards and frameworks is required, especially ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR, HIPAA, and CIS Controls.
* Understanding of risk assessment concepts, control documentation, and process\-based security work is preferred.
* Basic knowledge of GRC platforms, compliance tools, ticketing systems, or workflow\-based platforms will be an advantage.
* Basic coding knowledge is required, with familiarity in technologies such as Python, React, Node.js, or similar tools useful for platform support, automation, integrations, and technical coordination.
* Understanding of APIs, system integration basics, and data flow concepts will be beneficial for this role.
* Good documentation skills are essential, as the role involves preparing and maintaining process documents, policies, records, and support material.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills are important for working with internal teams and supporting compliance\-related coordination.
* Good analytical thinking, attention to detail, and willingness to learn are important for success in a GRC\-focused role.

**Working Model**

This is a full\-time role with Fourth Command and is suitable for candidates who are comfortable working in a structured professional environment with process\-driven responsibilities. The role may involve regular coordination with internal stakeholders, platform users, technical teams, and compliance\-related functions.

The position is best suited for candidates who are interested in long\-term growth in cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance operations, and platform\-based security process management. Consistency, discipline, and comfort with documentation\-heavy and process\-oriented work will be important in this role.

**Mindset and Commitment**

Fourth Command is looking for a candidate who is sincere, detail\-oriented, and genuinely interested in building a career in cybersecurity with a governance and risk focus. Since this is a junior role, the company will value learning attitude, accountability, and willingness to work patiently on structured tasks such as documentation, risk tracking, platform updates, and workflow support.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, organized, and capable of balancing technical understanding with process discipline. A strong sense of ownership, professional communication, and readiness to learn both business and security requirements will be important for long\-term success in this role.

This position is well suited for someone who wants to grow in the GRC domain by gaining hands\-on exposure to cybersecurity standards, risk assessment, platform management, workflow support, integrations, and security documentation in a professional consulting environment.

title: Intern – IT Support Engineer
description:
**Company Overview****Reward360 Global Services Pvt Ltd is India premier Customer Engagement Solutions Company. Headquartered in Bangalore with an office in Dubai and Singapore, our ‘Global’ loyalty solution has been built after years of deep understanding of consumers, the nuances of the loyalty diaspora, the onset of big data, and most important the simplicity that needs to be delivered across any loyalty program.** **Our Technology, Marketing, Alliances, Business, Product, and Operations teams work in collaboration to create and deliver the most successful loyalty programs in India today. With over 2000\+ retail alliances in India and access to over 10 million rewards globally, gives us the edge to be one of the most exciting and growing loyalty company in Asia.** **The only constant in today’s difficult and dynamic market is 'change'. Our team is dedicated to using behavioral patterns of customers combined with cutting edge technology to take complex problems that enterprises face today and simplify them. This helps make our programs more relevant and puts the customer on the path of true loyalty.** **About the Role**
We are looking for a proactive and technically curious IT Support Intern to join our growing Infrastructure team at Reward360\. This is a hands\-on internship where you will work alongside senior IT professionals to resolve technical issues, support day\-to\-day IT operations, and assist with hardware maintenance. You will gain real\-world exposure in an enterprise IT environment — building a strong foundation for a career in IT support or systems administration. **Key Responsibilities*** Provide first\-level technical support (L1\) to employees for hardware, software, and network\-related issues via helpdesk, email, or in\-person.
* Assemble, disassemble, and configure desktops and laptops as needed.
* Diagnose and replace faulty hardware components such as RAM, HDD/SSD, keyboards, screens, and power units.
* Set up and troubleshoot peripherals — monitors, printers, scanners, and projectors.
* Perform routine hardware maintenance including cleaning, inspection, and minor repairs.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot operating systems (primarily Windows 10/11\).
* Assist in onboarding new employees — device setup, account creation, and access provisioning.
* Monitor and maintain LAN/WAN connectivity, Wi\-Fi infrastructure, and basic network devices.
* Log and track all IT support tickets in the helpdesk system; escalate unresolved issues to seniors.
* Maintain an accurate inventory of IT assets — hardware, peripherals, and software licenses.
* Support the IT team with patch management, system health checks, and data backup procedures.
* Document troubleshooting steps and maintain a knowledge base for common issues.

 **Required Skills \& Qualifications*** Any Graduate or Diploma holder in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field — freshers are welcome.
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware components (RAM, HDD, motherboard, SMPS, etc.) and the ability to identify and replace common parts.
* Comfortable working with Windows OS (10/11\); exposure to macOS or Linux is a plus.

title: Junior IT Security Analyst
description:
**Job Overview**

Fourth Command is looking for a Junior IT Security Analyst for a technical cybersecurity role focused on supporting day\-to\-day security operations and helping protect client and internal environments from cyber threats. This role is suitable for a fresher or early\-career candidate who wants to build hands\-on experience in areas such as security monitoring, alert triage, vulnerability management, incident response support, endpoint security, network security, and technical documentation.

The selected candidate will work with the security team to monitor security tools, review alerts, support investigations, assist with vulnerability identification and remediation tracking, and help maintain the effectiveness of security controls across systems and platforms. Junior security analysts commonly support the front\-line technical work of identifying suspicious activity, analyzing security events, and helping improve an organization’s defensive posture.

This role is best suited for a candidate with a strong technical interest in cybersecurity, a willingness to learn hands\-on tools and processes, and a disciplined approach to analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation. The position also requires basic understanding of operating systems, networking, security tools, and coding or scripting concepts that can support automation and operational tasks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor security alerts and events generated by security tools such as SIEM, XDR, antivirus, endpoint protection, IDS/IPS, firewall logs, or related monitoring platforms, and support initial triage of suspicious activities.
* Assist in identifying, analyzing, and escalating security incidents based on severity, impact, and available evidence.
* Support incident response activities by collecting basic information, documenting observations, creating tickets, tracking actions, and coordinating with senior analysts or technical teams during investigations.
* Perform or support vulnerability assessment activities, including reviewing scan results, validating findings, tracking remediation progress, and maintaining vulnerability records.
* Assist in the configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of technical security tools and controls used across endpoint, network, server, cloud, or application environments.
* Review logs, alerts, and system behavior to help identify anomalies, suspicious patterns, or indicators of compromise.
* Support endpoint and system security activities such as patch follow\-up, antivirus status checks, system hardening coordination, access reviews, and compliance with basic security baselines.
* Work with internal teams to raise, track, and follow up on security issues, remediation actions, and operational tasks related to threats, vulnerabilities, or system weaknesses.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation such as incident notes, vulnerability trackers, asset observations, investigation records, standard operating procedures, and security support documents.
* Stay updated on emerging cyber threats, attacker techniques, common vulnerabilities, and security technologies relevant to operational defense and monitoring.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Fresher candidates can apply for this role.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred in:
* BSc (IT)
* BSc (Cyber Security)
* BSc (Computer Science)
* BCA
* Or other related technical backgrounds aligned to information security and systems support.
* Candidate must have a minimum academic qualification of above 7\.0 CGPA in their qualifying degree.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts such as threats, vulnerabilities, malware, phishing, endpoint security, network security, and incident handling is required.
* Familiarity with technical security domains such as SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, firewall basics, antivirus, log analysis, or IDS/IPS will be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of networking concepts such as IP addressing, ports, protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN, and firewalls is important for this role.
* Basic understanding of Windows, Linux, endpoints, user access, and system\-level security controls is preferred.
* Basic coding or scripting knowledge is required, with familiarity in Python, PowerShell, Bash, Node.js, React, or related technologies being useful for automation, tool support, integrations, and technical troubleshooting.

The role may require continuous coordination with internal security teams, technical teams, and project stakeholders for monitoring, investigation support, remediation follow\-up, and security operations activities.

The position is ideal for candidates who want practical exposure to technical cybersecurity work and are interested in building long\-term careers in security operations, threat monitoring, vulnerability management, detection engineering support, or incident response. The role demands consistency, focus, and readiness to learn tools, processes, and technologies used in real\-world cyber defense environments.

**Mindset and Commitment**

Fourth Command is looking for a candidate who is technically curious, disciplined, and committed to learning cybersecurity through hands\-on operational work. Since this is a junior role, the company will value sincerity, willingness to learn, strong observation skills, and the ability to follow structured security processes carefully and responsibly.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, alert, and comfortable working with logs, alerts, systems, and technical observations. A strong sense of ownership, timely escalation, professional communication, and a genuine interest in technical cybersecurity will be important for success in this role.

title: Analyst, Application Security [T500-26015]
description:
**About McDonald’s:** 




 One of the world’s largest employers with locations in more than 100 countries, McDonald’s Corporation has corporate opportunities in Hyderabad. Our global offices serve as dynamic innovation and operations hubs, designed to expand McDonald's global talent base and in\-house expertise. Our new office in Hyderabad will bring together knowledge across business, technology, analytics, and AI, accelerating our ability to deliver impactful solutions for the business and our customers across the globe.
 



  





**Analyst, External Application \& API Security – E\-WAAP** 



* Global Grade: G3
* Office Location: India
* Part Time / Full\-Time: Full Time



  





**Company Description:** 




 McDonald’s new growth strategy, Accelerating the Arches, is built on our ambition to Double Down on the 3Ds: Delivery, Digital, and Drive\-Thru. Technology is at the center of this strategy, enabling 65M\+ customers each day to enjoy fast, easy, and secure experiences across web, mobile, and restaurant channels.
 



  





 The Global Technology organization designs, builds, and operates the platforms behind our global omni\-channel experience. Within Global Technology, Global Cybersecurity Services (GCS) protects McDonald’s customers, crew, and brand by securing our digital ecosystem end\-to\-end.
 



 The External Web Application and API Protection (E\-WAAP) team is responsible for securing McDonald’s external web and API surfaces across web, mobile, and partner integrations using Akamai’s edge security platform (WAF, bot management, DDoS, CDN, and API security).
 



  





**Job Description:** 




 The Analyst, Application \& API Security role is an entry\-to\-early\-career position on the E\-WAAP team. As an Analyst, you focus on monitoring, initial triage, staging validation, and operational support for Akamai security configurations, working closely with Engineers and Senior Engineers.
 



 This role is a strong starting point for a career in application security, platform engineering, or cloud security.
 



  





**Responsibilities \& Accountabilities:** 




**Monitoring \& first\-line triage:** 



* Monitor Akamai dashboards (Grafana), alerts, and logs for unusual traffic, errors, or performance issues impacting web or API properties.
* Perform first\-line triage on alerts and tickets, gather context (affected application, timeframe, changes), and escalate to Engineers with clear summaries.
* Track incidents, changes, and requests in ServiceNow / Jira and ensure work items are correctly categorized and updated.



  





**Staging \& Validation:** 



* Support staging configuration reviews by validating that URLs, headers, origins, and basic WAF / route behavior match expectations.
* Execute standard validation playbooks (e.g., test paths, error scenarios, status codes) and document results for Engineers.
* Assist with post\-change and post\-deployment validations in production to confirm no negative user impact.



  





**Data Analysis \& Reporting:** 



* Collect and organize metrics related to WAF activity, attack trends, false positives, performance, and coverage; help prepare recurring reports.
* Perform basic log analysis using dashboards, queries, and filters to highlight spikes, notable patterns, or anomalies.



  





**Documentation \& Process:** 



* Maintain and update Confluence pages, runbooks, and SOPs for common tasks (validation steps, intake requirements, escalation paths).
* Help improve onboarding and intake templates used by application teams when requesting E\-WAAP services.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies to stay aligned on priorities and upcoming work, capturing action items and updating tickets.



  





**Qualifications:** 




**Basic Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2\-5 years of relevant experience in IT operations, support, security, or a related internship / apprenticeship.
* Basic understanding of Linux or cloud environments and basic scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar).
* Basic Understanding of HTTP, TLS, DNS, CDN, SDK concepts, and basic web development (HTML, JavaScript, APIs).
* Basic understanding of web technologies (HTTP, browsers, simple web application behavior) and an interest in security.
* Comfort working with dashboards, logs, and ticketing tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).
* Strong attention to detail, curiosity to learn, and willingness to follow structured processes and documentation.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Exposure to any WAF / CDN platform (Akamai, Cloudflare, F5, etc.) through coursework, labs, internships, or self\-learning.
* Experience using collaboration tools (Confluence, Jira, Teams) in a team environment.



  





**Additional Information:**

Job Description: Assembly Unit Manager

**Company:** 3\-GEE  
**Department:** Assembly / Production  
**Position:** Assembly Unit Manager  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** Rohini Sector 38 / Begumpur, Delhi

Job Summary

We are hiring an experienced **Assembly Unit Manager / Assembly Floor Incharge** to manage the complete assembly unit of our electrical accessories manufacturing business.

The candidate will be responsible for managing all activities inside the assembly building, including worker management, task allocation, quality checks, raw material issue, inventory tracking, stock management, shortages, material inflow/outflow, efficiency improvement, and daily reporting.

The candidate must have **minimum 5 years of experience** in factory, production, assembly, or manufacturing unit management. Experience in an **Electrical Accessories Manufacturing Unit** and **Assembly Unit Management** will be strongly preferred.

Key ResponsibilitiesAssembly Unit Management

* Manage complete day\-to\-day operations of the assembly unit.
* Ensure smooth functioning of all assembly activities.
* Plan and assign daily work to workers based on priority, material availability, and production requirements.
* Monitor daily output and ensure assembly targets are achieved.
* Handle general daily problems on the assembly floor.
* Maintain discipline, cleanliness, and proper arrangement inside the assembly unit.

Worker Management

* Manage both piece\-rate workers and salary\-based workers.
* Assign tasks to workers and monitor their daily work.
* Track worker\-wise output, especially for piece\-rate workers.
* Ensure workers are working efficiently and not sitting idle.
* Monitor worker performance, speed, accuracy, and discipline.
* Report absenteeism, low performance, delays, or work\-related issues to management.

Raw Material, Inventory \& Stock Management

* Issue required raw materials and components to workers for assembly.
* Ensure workers receive correct materials in correct quantities.
* Track raw material issued, finished goods received, rejected pieces, and balance material.
* Maintain proper inventory and stock records.
* Monitor shortages of raw materials, components, tools, and other assembly requirements.
* Inform management in advance about material shortages and requirements.
* Prevent wastage, misuse, loss, theft, or mixing of materials.
* Maintain proper inflow and outflow records of materials.

Quality Checking

* Check quality of assembled products as per company standards.
* Ensure products are assembled correctly before sending them for packing.
* Check fitting, finishing, movement, alignment, screws, contacts, springs, and other components.
* Identify defective or rejected pieces and keep them separately.
* Maintain rejection and quality issue records.
* Ensure only properly checked goods are sent forward to the packing department.

Material Inflow \& Outflow Tracking

* Maintain records of raw material received in the assembly unit.
* Maintain records of material issued to workers.
* Track finished goods produced by the assembly unit.
* Track rejected, pending, and balance material.
* Coordinate with production, store, packing, and dispatch teams.
* Ensure proper handover of finished goods to the packing department.

Efficiency \& Productivity

* Improve worker efficiency and assembly output.
* Reduce idle time, delays, wastage, and repeated mistakes.
* Ensure urgent orders and priority items are completed on time.
* Plan daily work according to available manpower and material.
* Suggest improvements in assembly process, worker allocation, and material handling.

Reports \& Documentation

* Maintain daily production and assembly reports.
* Maintain worker\-wise output records.
* Maintain raw material issue and balance records.
* Maintain shortage, rejection, and pending work reports.
* Maintain stock and inventory records.
* Prepare reports in registers and Microsoft Excel.
* Submit daily work report to management.

Required Experience

* Minimum **5 years of experience** in factory, production, assembly, or manufacturing unit supervision/management.
* Experience in managing an **assembly unit** is required.
* Experience in **Electrical Accessories Manufacturing Unit** will be strongly preferred.
* Experience in managing both **piece\-rate workers** and **salary\-based workers** will be preferred.
* Experience in raw material tracking, inventory management, stock management, quality checking, and worker output tracking is required.

Required Skills

* Well\-versed with **Microsoft Excel**.
* Good knowledge of **inventory management and stock management**.
* Good knowledge of raw material issue, material tracking, and finished goods tracking.
* Good worker management and task allocation skills.
* Good counting, checking, and calculation ability.
* Ability to maintain registers, reports, and Excel sheets.
* Basic quality checking knowledge.
* Ability to handle daily factory floor problems.
* Responsible, punctual, disciplined, and active on the factory floor.
* Able to manage pressure, workers, shortages, and daily production requirements.

Candidate Preference

* Candidate should preferably be from the **Electrical Accessories / Electrical Goods / Switches / Sockets / Plastic Electrical Products** industry.
* Candidate should have practical experience in managing an assembly unit.
* Candidate should be nearby and comfortable travelling daily to **Rohini Sector 38 / Begumpur** for work.

India \& International (Global)

**About We Founder Circle (WFC) Group**

We Founder Circle (WFC) Group is a dynamic ecosystem builder at the intersection of entrepreneurship, investment, and innovation. With a strong and growing presence across India and international markets, WFC empowers founders, investors, and financial professionals to grow and thrive. Through its Fintech and Wealthtech vertical, WFC is building cutting\-edge platforms and products that redefine how wealth is created, managed, and distributed both within India and across global markets including the Middle East, Southeast Asia, the UK, and beyond.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a driven and commercially sharp Business Development Manager to spearhead new business opportunities within WFC’s Fintech \& Wealthtech vertical owning the full journey from discovery and evaluation through to transition and execution. The primary objective of this role is to drive strategic diversification beyond startup investments, by identifying and assessing high\-potential opportunities across both established and newly initiated Fintech and Wealthtech business models. The ideal candidate will bring structured thinking and strong initiative, with the ability to study emerging business models, size opportunities, and build the groundwork for WFC to enter or build in new spaces. This role demands active, on\-ground engagement with a broad stakeholder ecosystem including founders, HNIs, family offices, wealth managers, and institutional partners and will involve travel as needed to build and deepen these relationships across key markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Growth \& Revenue**

▸ Identify and spearhead new business opportunities across the Fintech and Wealthtech landscape, leading each initiative from initial discovery through to transition and execution

▸ Drive diversification beyond startup investments by identifying and evaluating both established and newly initiated Fintech and Wealthtech business models

▸ Study, assess, and map the competitive and collaborative landscape of existing and emerging Fintech and Wealthtech business models to surface actionable diversification opportunities

▸ Engage with founders, HNIs, family offices, wealth managers, and institutional partners through active travel and outreach to uncover and qualify new business opportunities

▸ Build and present compelling business cases, opportunity decks, and transition plans to leadership for new initiatives across India and global markets

▸ Track and report on opportunity pipeline health, business model evaluations, and progress on diversification milestones on a regular basis

**New Business Opportunity Development**

▸ Identify white\-space opportunities in underserved fintech and wealthtech market segments across pan\-India and globally

▸ Develop new revenue streams by introducing innovative financial products, co\-branded solutions, and platform integrations

▸ Forge first\-of\-its\-kind partnerships with fintech startups, digital lenders, AI\-advisory platforms, and investment tech firms

▸ Prepare detailed new business proposals, opportunity decks, and partnership term sheets for senior stakeholder review

▸ Track and report on new opportunity pipeline health, conversion rates, and revenue contribution on a regular basis

**Partnerships \& Ecosystem Development**

▸ Collaborate with wealth management firms, family offices, and HNI networks (Globally) for product distribution

▸ Represent WFC at industry events, investor forums, and fintech conferences across India and outside India

▸ Nurture long\-term relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers in the financial ecosystem

**Market Strategy \& Expansion**

▸ Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis across India and international markets to identify growth opportunities

▸ Develop go\-to\-market strategies for new products and services in the Wealthtech space tailored for both domestic and global audiences

▸ Analyze market trends, client needs, and competitor landscape across geographies to inform product positioning and pricing

▸ Drive entry into new international markets including the Middle East, Southeast Asia, the UK, and other high\-potential regions

**Client Acquisition \& Retention**

**Cross\-functional Collaboration**

▸ Prepare business proposals, presentations, and pitch decks for potential partners and investors

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

▸ MBA from a reputed institution or CA (Chartered Accountant) preferred; CFA / CFP / NISM certifications are an added advantage

title: HR Strategy - Intern
description:
****What Do We Do:****
 ShopDeck helps e\-commerce merchants set up and manage their D2C storefront profitably.
   

  

**Proposition For Merchants:**
 D2C selling made as easy as selling on marketplaces like Amazon, Flipkart or Myntra/
   

  

****Why Build This:****
* India’s D2C wave has been limited to venture\-funded D2C brands today
* The art of selling on your own website is not democratised. There are \~500k\-1M sellers who can sell D2C but can at best sell on marketplaces
* Philosophically \- we feel brand owners should spend most of their time on the product and not on channel optimization
* Shopify / Status\-quo software solve for work\-flow management of storefront but don’t do enough on “helping” merchants sell well!


****Team And Scale:****
 We’re at \~$8M ARR and had hit profitability earlier in the year. We’ve recently raised series\-B from led by Bessemer Venture Partners (who had famously led Series A for Shopify in 2010\) with participation from Elevation Capital, General Catalyst (fka Venture Highway) and Chiratae Ventures.
   

  

**HR Strategy Intern :\-
   

  

 Role Overview**
 Location: Bengaluru \| In\-office
   

  

 Duration: 3–6 months
   

  

 Team: HR / People Strategy
   

  

****About The Role****
 We are looking for a high\-ownership HR Strategy Intern who wants to work closely with the HR team on building scalable people systems for a fast\-growing startup.
   

  

 This is not a routine HR internship. You will get exposure to performance management, culture\-building, HR automation, employee engagement, manager enablement, and HRBP execution. The role is ideal for someone who is structured, analytical, execution\-focused, and eager to learn how high\-impact HR systems are built from scratch.
   

  

 What You Will Work On
   

  

* Performance \& Growth


 You will support the HR team in building and improving performance management systems across the company.
   

  

**You Will Work On:**
* Creating and maintaining performance scorecards, review trackers, calibration inputs, and performance cycle documentation.
* Supporting career pathing work across functions, including IC and Manager tracks.
* Helping define role expectations, competency frameworks, level definitions, and promotion criteria.
* Assisting in performance fairness checks through data, documentation, and calibration support.
* Supporting the design and execution of Reward \& Recognition frameworks linked to company values and business outcomes.
* Preparing manager toolkits, communication drafts, review templates, and performance enablement material.
* Culture \& Values


 You will help convert company values into practical, observable behaviors that teams can understand and apply.
   

  

**You Will Work On:**
* Translating company values into simple behavior definitions and examples.
* Supporting culture rituals such as onboarding sessions, manager rituals, recognition moments, and employee engagement programs.
* Helping maintain the Employee Handbook, culture playbooks, and HR communication material.
* Supporting initiatives that improve adoption of people practices across teams.
* Creating simple, engaging content to make HR policies, values, and rituals easier to understand.
* AI\-led HR Ops \& Automation


 You will support HR Ops automation and process improvement projects.
   

  

**You Will Work On:**
* Mapping HR processes such as letters, approvals, onboarding, offboarding, policy queries, FAQs, and recurring reports.
* Identifying manual work that can be automated using tools, workflows, templates, trackers, and AI.
* Supporting the creation of SOPs, dashboards, SLA trackers, and process documentation.
* Helping improve HRIS hygiene, employee data accuracy, and recurring HR reporting.
* Working with the HR team to make HR Ops more process\-first, automation\-first, and scalable.
* HRBP Execution \& Change Management


 You will support HRBPs in driving adoption of key people initiatives across teams.
   

  

**You Will Work On:**
* Helping managers understand and use new HR frameworks, templates, and processes.
* Supporting employee communication, training material, and enablement sessions.
* Preparing people dashboards, org insights, and review notes for leadership discussions.
* Assisting in tracking people risks, engagement inputs, manager feedback, and action items.
* Supporting change management for new HR initiatives across pods and functions.


****What We Are Looking ForMust Have****
* Hunger to learn, take ownership, and work in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* Good comfort with Excel/Google Sheets, documentation, and structured thinking.
* Ability to convert ambiguous problems into simple trackers, templates, and action plans.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and build trust across teams.


****Preferred****
* MBA/PGDM student or recent graduate with specialization in HR, Organizational Behaviour, Strategy, or related fields.
* Prior internship or project experience in HR, consulting, startups, people analytics, L\&D, or HR operations.
* Interest in AI\-led automation, people analytics, culture\-building, and performance management.


****What You Will Learn****
* How performance management systems are designed and run in a high\-growth company.
* How to build scalable HR processes, dashboards, SOPs, and operating rhythms.
* How HR partners with business leaders on performance, culture, org design, and people risks.
* How to use data, automation, and structured thinking to solve real HR problems.
* How startup HR works beyond routine operations.


**Note:** 
 This is a paid internship.Skills: hr operations,advanced excel skills,hr strategy

title: Global Mobility Delivery Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


You will be responsible for the end\-to\-end execution of global mobility cases for consulting staff, acting as the primary point of contact for transferees and offices and ensuring smooth, compliant, and high\-quality delivery of geographic transfers.

  

As part of a global delivery team, you will manage a portfolio of consulting team geographic transfers, working within established policies and frameworks. You will focus on consistent execution, stakeholder coordination, and operational excellence, while escalating complex or out\-of\-policy cases to the appropriate teams.

  

* Act as the primary point of contact for transferees and offices, addressing questions and guiding them through the mobility process
* Be responsible for end\-to\-end execution of consulting team geographic transfers, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of all required steps
* Coordinate with home and host offices to confirm transfer details, including dates and logistics
* Set transfer terms within established policies and frameworks, ensuring consistency and accuracy
* Prepare cost estimates and employee net pay illustrations using Assignment Pro
* Conduct pre\-move briefings and provide ongoing support throughout the mobility lifecycle
* Liaise with vendors during execution to ensure services are delivered effectively
* Ensure operational excellence across all cases, including accuracy, compliance with internal policies and external requirements, and adherence to timelines

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
   

  

 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
   

  

**Job Function**
 Human Resources
   

  

**Job Sub Function**
 HR Operations
   

  

**Job Category**
 People Leader
   

  

**All Job Posting Locations:**
 Bangalore, Karnataka, India
   

  

**Job Description**
 DePuy Synthes is recruiting for a(n) Director, HR Digital Experience, located in Pune, Maharashtra.
   

  

 The Director, HR Digital Experience provides strategic and operational leadership for the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of digital HR experiences at DePuy Synthes. This role is responsible for shaping a seamless, user‑centric HR digital ecosystem that enhances employee experience, enables efficiency, and supports scalable global operations. The position plays a critical role in driving digital transformation across HR, improving adoption of HR technologies, and ensuring alignment between people processes, technology, and business priorities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the HR digital experience strategy, ensuring alignment with HR, IT, and business objectives.
* Oversee the design and optimization of employee and manager digital touchpoints across HR platforms.
* Drive adoption, usability, and continuous improvement of HR systems and digital tools.
* Partner with HR Centers of Excellence, IT, and global stakeholders to translate business needs into digital solutions.
* Establish governance, standards, and metrics for HR digital experience and service performance.
* Lead digital transformation initiatives, including automation and process simplification.
* Manage vendors and technology partners to ensure delivery quality, value, and compliance.
* Build, develop, and lead high‑performing teams focused on HR digital experience and operations.


**Qualifications**
*Education:*
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field is required.
* Master’s degree or MBA is preferred.


**Required**
*Experience and Skills:*
* Typically 10\-12 years of progressive experience in HR technology, digital transformation, HR operations, or related leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise‑scale HR digital or technology initiatives.
* Strong understanding of HR processes, employee experience, and digital service design.
* Proven ability to partner with senior stakeholders in a matrixed, global organization.
* Strong analytical, operational, and problem‑solving skills.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and change‑management capabilities.


**Preferred**
* Experience supporting global HR platforms, specifically Workday HCM, and shared services models.
* Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, medical devices, or life sciences.
* Experience leading automation, digital adoption, or HR experience transformation initiatives.
* Familiarity with HR systems, analytics, and service management frameworks.
* Experience working across multiple geographies and cultures.


**Other**
* Languages: English proficiency is required.
* Travel: Up to 20–30% domestic or international travel.
* Certifications: HR technology, digital transformation, Agile, or project management certifications are preferred.
* For more information on how we support the whole health of our employees throughout their wellness, career and life journey, please visit www.careers.jnj.com.


 Johnson \& Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

title: Regional Training Manager
job_function: Consulting, Human Resources, and Business Development
description:
***Position Overview***




  





 The Senior Manager – Regional Training Manager will be based out of
 **Mumbai** 
 and will lead training delivery across
 **multiple branches** 
 in the assigned region. The role is responsible for strengthening employee capability through functional, behavioural, and digital learning interventions. The position requires strong facilitation skills (classroom and virtual), content creation capability, and proven experience within the
 **financial services industry** 
 .
 



  





***Position Details***



* **Role:** 
 Senior Manager / Manager – Regional Training Manager
* **Location:** 
 Mumbai (MIDC Andheri)
* **Scope:** 
 Responsible for managing and supporting training needs across
 **multiple branches** 
 within the region.



  





***Key Responsibilities***




**Training Delivery \& Facilitation** 



* Conduct Induction, Refresher, Functional, Product, and Behavioral training sessions for employees.
* Facilitate training for customers, channel partners, and B2B stakeholders when required.
* Deliver learning effectively across both
 **classroom** 
 and
 **virtual (VILT)** 
 formats.
* Travel across the region to support branches, conduct sessions, and ensure consistent training delivery.
* Partner with branch leadership to identify gaps and recommend suitable training interventions.



**Digital Learning \& Content Creation** 



* Create clear, engaging training material—presentations, guides, short videos, assessments, and simple digital modules.
* Refresh and modernize existing content so it is easy to understand and accessible in digital formats.
* Use tools like
 **Canva** 
 and other
 **AI\-based tools** 
 to improve the quality, design, and delivery of learning material.
* Support Train\-the\-Trainer (TTT) programs by preparing easy\-to\-use content and helping design smooth digital learning experiences.



**Stakeholder Management** 



* Work closely with Product Managers, SMEs, Operations, HR, and internal trainers to ensure accurate, updated training delivery.
* Build strong working relationships with regional/branch managers to understand business priorities and capability needs.
* Communicate training plans, outcomes, and feedback effectively to leadership and stakeholders.



**Process \& Documentation** 



* Maintain training MIS, reports, attendance, participant feedback, and assessments.
* Ensure documentation is audit\-ready and aligned to internal compliance standards.
* Track training effectiveness and share insights for continuous improvement.



  





***Skills \& Competencies Required***




**Training \& Facilitation Skills** 



* Strong facilitation skills across physical classrooms as well as virtual platforms (VILT).
* Ability to engage participants and simplify complex topics for diverse audiences.
* Experience delivering behavioral and soft\-skills training is preferred.



**Content Development \& Digital Skills** 



* Ability to create simple, engaging, and visually appealing digital training content.
* Working knowledge of
 **Canva** 
 and comfort using
 **AI tools** 
 for content creation, visuals, and basic video elements.
* Familiarity with LMS usage and digital learning platforms.



**Behavioral Competencies** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capability.
* High level of ownership, planning, and organizational ability to manage multiple branches.



  





***Qualifications \& Experience***



* **Mandatory:** 
 8\-10 years of experience overall of which minimum 3 in
 **financial services** 
 (Broking, BFSI, Wealth, Insurance or related domains) in a sales training or capability\-building role.
* Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline. Certifications in L\&D, facilitation, or instructional design are an advantage.
* Experience handling multi\-location training delivery and virtual sessions is desirable.
* Basic Proficiency in Canva, digital tools, and AI\-based content creation platforms is required.

description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting\-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.
 



  





 Our diverse 4,000\+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.
 



  





 When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.
 



  





 Talent Acquisition Associate at BairesDev
 



  





 In the role of Talent Acquisition Associate (TAA), you will be responsible for managing comprehensive recruitment processes from beginning to end. This pivotal position requires conducting thorough candidate interviews, developing a deep understanding of candidate profiles, and effectively engaging potential hires in our selection process. The successful candidate will utilize their exceptional interpersonal abilities to connect with candidates, demonstrate genuine interest in applicant conversations, and maintain meticulous attention to detail throughout all recruitment activities.

 \- Managing outreach to potential candidates through various communication channels including phone calls, Zoom, LinkedIn, and email.
 



 \- Conducting comprehensive interviews to evaluate candidates' qualifications, experience, interests, commitment, and logical reasoning abilities.
 



 \- Overseeing the complete recruitment lifecycle while ensuring accurate and timely system documentation.
 



 \- Building relationships with candidates to maintain their engagement throughout the hiring process.

 \- Experience: At least 4 years in full\-cycle recruitment processes.
 



 \- Communication Skills: Strong interpersonal and communication abilities to effectively engage with candidates.
 



 \- Technical Proficiency: Experience with recruitment platforms and applicant tracking systems.
 



 \- Relationship Building: Demonstrated ability to establish rapport with candidates from diverse cultural backgrounds.
 



 \- Organizational Abilities: Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
 



 \- Location: Must be based in India.
 



 \- Language Skills: Advanced proficiency in English.
 



  





 How we make your work (and your life) easier:
 



  





 \- 100% remote \- work from anywhere.
 



 \- Excellent compensation in USD.
 



 \- Hardware setup for you to work from home.
 



 \- Flexible hours \- make your schedule.
 



 \- Paid parental leave, vacation, \& national holidays.
 



 \- Innovative and multicultural work environment.
 



 \- Collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent in each area.
 



 \- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.
 



  





 Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

title: HR & Admin Lead
description:
**About Aramya** 




 Our vision is to build some of the world's most loved fashion and lifestyle brands and enable people to express themselves. We are well\-funded, with $20M raised from marquee investors like Accel, Z47, and industry veterans.
 



  





 Aramya is a 100 Cr\+ NMV fashion \& lifestyle company backed by Accel and Z47\. We're building a customer\-led portfolio: Aramya (daily wear), Tavira by Aramya (festive), and a new brand in stealth, going live in H2 2026\.
 



  





 Current Retail footprint: 14 stores in Bengaluru (and a few more are yet to go live).
 



 Opening next: Hyderabad and Chennai. Pune, Ahmedabad and Mumbai in the pipeline.
 



  





 Website: https://aramya.in/
 



 Our Team: https://shorturl.at/l6u
 



  





**About the Opportunity** 




 We are seeking an execution\-driven HR Generalist to manage day\-to\-day HR operations and support people initiatives in a fast\-growing startup environment. This role will play a key part in strengthening HR processes, employee experience, and operational excellence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle: onboarding, documentation, confirmation, exits, and HR records.
* Own and manage HRMS platforms such as Keka / GreytHR, including employee data, attendance, leave, and payroll inputs.
* Act as the first point of contact for employee HR queries and policy clarifications.
* Support hiring logistics, interview coordination, and onboarding experience.
* Assist in payroll coordination, attendance validation, and monthly HR reporting.
* Support performance management cycles and HR initiatives.
* Drive employee engagement activities and internal communication.
* Ensure adherence to internal HR policies and basic statutory compliance.



  





**Key Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 3\+ years of experience in an HR Generalist / HR Operations role.
* Hands\-on experience with HRMS platforms and tools.
* Strong understanding of core HR operations and HRMS workflows.
* Prior exposure to startup or fast\-paced environments preferred.
* Strong coordination, communication, and execution skills.
* High ownership mindset with attention to detail.

title: Talent Acquisition Coord
description:
**Overview**
 As a Recruitment Coordinator, you will play a key role in ensuring seamless execution of recruitment coordination processes for hiring category: North America Professional External Hiring. You will be responsible for managing requisition processing, interview scheduling, offer management, pre\-boarding, and onboarding activities, while ensuring compliance, data integrity, and process adherence.
   

  

 This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, stakeholder collaboration, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced environment. You will work closely with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, Talent Acquisition Leaders, and HR teams to deliver an exceptional recruitment experience for both candidates and internal stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Recruitment Coordination \& Process Management
   

  

* Requisition Management: Ensure accurate entry, updates, and maintenance of job requisitions within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Interview Scheduling \& Coordination: Manage and coordinate interview schedules with candidates, hiring managers, and interviewers to ensure timely and professional interview logistics.
* Offer \& Pre\-boarding Support:
+ Assist in the preparation and issuance of offer letters ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery.
+ Facilitate background checks, tracking progress, and resolving any related issues.

* Onboarding Coordination:
+ Support pre\-boarding activities, including new hire documentation and orientation scheduling.
+ Ensure a smooth transition for new hires, resolving any onboarding\-related concerns efficiently.

* Process Oversight: Monitor all aspects of the recruitment lifecycle, ensuring timely completion of each stage while maintaining high service standards.


 Data Management \& Reporting
   

  

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate records within the ATS and other recruitment systems.
* Ensure data integrity and compliance with company policies and data privacy regulations.
* Generate basic reports on recruitment activities, tracking process completion rates, candidate status, and coordination efficiency.


 Stakeholder Management \& Communication
   

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, HR Teams, and Candidates.
* Provide timely updates on the status of coordination activities, ensuring clear communication and alignment.
* Ensure candidates receive a high\-touch experience, keeping them informed throughout the interview and hiring process.


 Process Improvement \& Technology Utilization
   

  

* Identify and suggest process improvements to streamline coordination activities and enhance efficiency.
* Utilize the ATS, CRM, and other recruitment tools to ensure timely and accurate execution of coordination activities.
* Stay updated on system and process changes, ensuring proper adoption and compliance.


 Compliance \& Process Adherence
   

  

* Ensure all recruitment activities comply with local employment laws, company policies, and global hiring standards.
* Maintain accurate data entry and tracking within the ATS, ensuring full compliance with recruitment lifecycle protocols.
* Safeguard the accuracy and completeness of candidate records, ensuring adherence to data privacy regulations.


 Specialized Responsibilities Based on Coordination Type
   

  

* Coordinate high\-volume hiring processes for external professional, early talent, and frontline recruitment.
* Work closely with campus recruitment teams, operations managers, and talent partners to ensure timely hiring.
* Manage external candidate engagement, ensuring a smooth recruitment journey from interview scheduling to onboarding.


**Qualifications**
 Education \& Experience:
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree and 2\+ years of experience in recruitment coordination, HR operations, or talent acquisition support.
* Talent Acquisition Technology Expertise: Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) (e.g., iCIMS, Workday, SuccessFactors) and recruitment technologies.
* Organizational \& Time Management Skills: Strong ability to manage multiple priorities, high\-volume hiring processes, and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Communication \& Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Process \& Compliance Adherence: Understanding of global hiring standards, local employment laws, and recruitment lifecycle protocols to ensure compliance and data integrity.
* Attention to Detail: Strong focus on accuracy in offer processing, scheduling, and data management to maintain seamless recruitment coordination.
* Collaboration \& Confidentiality: Ability to work collaboratively across teams while maintaining discretion in handling sensitive candidate information.
* Candidate Experience Management: Strong customer service orientation to ensure a high\-touch candidate experience throughout the interview and onboarding process.
* Proficiency in English: Strong written and spoken English skills to support recruitment coordination across regions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* High\-Volume Hiring Expertise: Experience supporting external professional, early talent, or frontline hiring processes in a high\-volume recruitment environment.
* HR Systems \& Data Management: Familiarity with recruitment workflows, HR processes, and system\-generated analytics to support reporting and insights.
* Process Improvement Mindset: Ability to identify opportunities for operational efficiency and suggest enhancements to streamline coordination activities.

description:
Here at Appian, our values of
 **Intensity** 
 and
 **Excellence** 
 define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.
 



 About the role:
 



 We are seeking a detail\-oriented 
 **Talent Coordinator** 
 to support our Talent Acquisition efforts across the
 **APJ region** 
 . In this role, you will be responsible for the logistical execution of our hiring process, ensuring a professional and seamless experience for candidates and hiring teams alike.
 



 You will manage high\-volume scheduling across multiple time zones and serve as a critical link between recruiters, hiring managers, and prospective employees.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * **Regional Coordination:** 
  Manage end\-to\-end interview logistics specifically for the 
 **APJ region**

* **ATS Management:** 
  Maintain high data integrity within 
 **Greenhouse**

* **Hybrid Scheduling:**

  and 
 **in\-office visits**

  Act as the primary point of contact for candidates, providing timely updates and clear preparation materials throughout the interview loop.

* Qualifications

 2 to 5 years of experience in recruitment operations, HR coordination, or a high\-volume administrative role.

  Previous experience supporting the 
 **APJ market** 
  is essential.
* **Operational Flexibility:** 
  Ability to manage your desk across various time zones to meet the needs of the APJ recruitment cycle.
* **Volume Management:** 
  Proven ability to handle a high volume of tasks simultaneously while maintaining strict attention to detail.
* **Professional Assertiveness:** 
  The confidence to manage expectations with internal teams and advocate for process improvements.
* **Critical Thinking:** 
  Strong problem\-solving abilities; you can anticipate potential roadblocks and proactively suggest solutions.

Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First\-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee\-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

 Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future.
