title: Co-Founder and Medical Doctor (MBBS)
description:
About Mednevo

Mednevo is an early\-stage AI healthcare startup revolutionizing \*primary healthcare\* in India. We combine \*cutting\-edge AI technology\* with a genuine patient\-first approach to deliver accessible, personalized, and high\-quality care. Our platform integrates \*on\-demand virtual consultations, in\-home doctor visits, proactive wellness monitoring, and AI\-powered tools for interactive consultations, patient education, and personalized health insights.

We are particularly focused on making quality care — including pediatric care — more efficient, affordable, and scalable across urban and semi\-urban India. As a small, high\-impact team (2\-10 people), we move fast and solve real problems: reducing wait times, supporting clinical decisions with AI, improving outcomes for families and children, and building the future of intelligent healthcare delivery.

The Opportunity We are looking for a passionate Medical Doctor to join as a Co\-Founder. This is not a traditional clinical job — it is a founding leadership role where you will shape the clinical vision, build the product alongside AI engineers, and help scale a mission\-driven healthcare ecosystem. You will bring real\-world medical expertise (especially in pediatrics) to ensure our AI tools are clinically accurate, safe, empathetic, and truly useful for Indian families and doctors.

Key Responsibilities **⁠ ⁠**

**Clinical Leadership \& Product Vision: Co\-define the medical strategy and clinical pathways, with special focus on pediatric care, primary health, preventive wellness, and common childhood conditions.** ⁠ ⁠AI \+ Medicine Integration: Work closely with AI engineers to train, validate, and refine AI models for symptom assessment, triage, personalized advice, and decision support. Provide clinical oversight to ensure safety and accuracy. **⁠ ⁠**

**Patient Care Excellence: Lead or supervise virtual consultations and in\-home visits (initially hands\-on, later more strategic). Help design workflows that blend human empathy with AI efficiency.** ⁠ ⁠Product Development: Collaborate on building user\-friendly tools for doctors, patients, and parents — including pediatric growth tracking, vaccination reminders, developmental screening, and family health management. **⁠ ⁠**

**Regulatory \& Quality: Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, data privacy (HIPAA\-like standards), and medical ethics in India.** ⁠ ⁠Growth \& Ecosystem Building: Support fundraising, partnerships with hospitals/clinics, go\-to\-market strategy, and expansion of our AI\-hospital ecosystem. Represent Mednevo at medical conferences and among the doctor community.

**⁠ ⁠Team \& Culture: Help build a high\-trust, innovative team culture that attracts top medical and tech talent. What We’re Looking For** ⁠ ⁠Medical Qualification: MBBS from a recognized institution (mandatory). MD/DNB Pediatrics (pursuing or completed) is a strong advantage. **⁠ ⁠**

**Experience: 0\-2 years post\-MBBS (including internships or residency). Fresh graduates or final\-year MD candidates with strong academic records and genuine interest in technology are encouraged to apply.** ⁠ ⁠Passion for AI \& Innovation: Curiosity or experience in digital health, telemedicine, or AI applications in medicine. No prior tech experience required — we value clinical insight and willingness to learn. **⁠** 

**⁠Pediatric Interest: Strong preference for candidates with exposure to or deep interest in pediatrics — child health, neonatology, developmental pediatrics, or family medicine.** ⁠ ⁠Founder Mindset: Entrepreneurial spirit, ownership attitude, resilience, and excitement about building something from the ground up. Ability to wear multiple hats in a fast\-paced startup. **⁠ ⁠Skills: Excellent communication (especially with patients/parents), empathy, basic tech\-savviness, and comfort working in a remote/hybrid setup.** ⁠ ⁠Location: Open to candidates in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, or willing to relocate/base in Chennai/Thiruvananthapuram. What We Offer

**⁠ ⁠Significant Equity: As a Co\-Founder, you will receive meaningful ownership in the company — your impact will directly translate into long\-term rewards.** ⁠ ⁠Competitive Compensation: Stipend during the early phase, transitioning to market\-competitive pay as we grow and secure funding. **⁠ ⁠**

**Learning \& Impact: Direct mentorship from the Founder \& CEO. Opportunity to shape AI tools that can impact thousands of patients, especially children and families.** ⁠ ⁠Flexible Work: Remote\-first with support for in\-person clinical or team activities. **⁠ ⁠**

**Growth: Be part of a mission\-driven team at the intersection of AI, pediatrics, and healthcare innovation in one of India’s fastest\-growing sectors. If you are a doctor who dreams of using your medical knowledge to build the next generation of intelligent healthcare — rather than just practicing in the traditional system — this is your chance to become a true Co\-Founder. We review applications on a rolling basis and respond to shortlisted candidates quickly.** 

**Mednevo – Making healthcare smarter, kinder, and more accessible for every Indian family.**

description:
**Job Description**
 Job Description
   

  

 Join a High\-Performance Culture That Drives Innovation and Excellence
   

  

 At Vertiv, we don’t just hire talent—we cultivate leaders who drive innovation and engage teams to push the limits of what’s possible. As a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, we are scaling up to meet the demands of AI, data centers, and next\-gen technology—and we need bold, high\-performing individuals like YOU to take us to the next level.
   

  

 Why Vertiv?
   

  

* High\-Performance Culture: We empower you to think big, execute with excellence, and deliver impact. Our performance\-driven mindset rewards those who challenge the status quo and drive meaningful change. Over 50 CEO Awards are given annually to recognize top talent moving the needle forward.
* Leadership Without Limits: Leadership at Vertiv goes beyond just titles—it’s about accountability, trust, and ownership. Our leaders engage and drive with collaboration, innovation, and customer\-centric thinking, setting the foundation for an action\-focused culture.
* Limitless Growth \& Learning: We believe in continuous development. Whether through rotational programs or high\-impact projects, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your expertise and grow your career.
* A Place for Everyone: Our commitment to inclusion ensures that all employee’s unique strengths and perspectives are valued. Your voice matters, your growth is prioritized, and your success is celebrated.


 Role Overview
   

  

 The Analyst II \| Application and Product Security is responsible for conducting security pen testing, monitoring, and auditing within a dynamic global organization. The products under test will have the coverage of embedded devices and cloud services. The Senior Pen Tester should have exposure to embedded devices as well as cloud services (AWS/Azure). Some of the products will be white box tests while others will be total black box engagements. A successful Senior Pen Tester will be able to take the product and evaluate the weak points in the design and implementation and focus in on those weaknesses to find security gaps. All the findings by the Senior Pen Tester will need to be clearly documented and relayed to the design team for mitigation. The Senior Pen Tester will need to be very versatile in their attack vectors and their knowledge of exploits. The ideal candidate will be well experienced in a broad range of attack vectors across a wide spectrum of devices from small, embedded devices to wide and complex cloud ecosystems.
   

  

 They will be responsible for interfacing with engineering teams to conduct security testing, auditing and should be able to explain the findings. They will be responsible for ensuring that engineering teams stay in compliance with the security expectations of the global organization. The Senior Pen Tester will be expected to stay current with the latest security threats and attack vectors that can be deployed against the product portfolio. They should also have experience in communicating clearly and concisely the findings of these activities to an audience.
   

  

 The testing activity and methodology deployed to confirm compliance is guided but expected to be enhanced by the Senior Pen Tester. The Senior Pen Tester will be expected to use their knowledge and experience to further develop internal testing processes and procedures.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

**Duties**
 In addition to performing internal application and product security assessments the Analyst II \| Application and Product Security will be expected to support response to possible breaches of security based on newly disclosed information. Other key duties include:
   

  

* Conduct security evaluation and threat assessments of embedded systems, mobile applications, web applications
* Conduct research for the purposes of finding new vulnerabilities and enhancing existing capabilities
* Circumventing security protection methods and techniques
* Performing data bus monitoring (snooping) and data injection
* Conduct communications protocol analysis in the embedded products, and applications
* Conduct wireless communications channel snooping, and data injection
* Reverse engineering complex systems and protocols
* Create detailed technical reports and proof of concept code to document findings
* Perform System Breakdown of the project/product before testing, identify and evaluate all the testing requirements and plan out the detailed testing activities, resources etc.
* Proactive detailed interaction with respective engineering group on the testing needs, testing progress/status and provide detailed analysis report
* Have effective Gitlab issue management reviewing and, providing mentorship and direction on planned testing activities for junior resources in line with defined processes and procedures. Assist in leading testing activities in all the regions, provide head\-to\-head support to Assessment Pillar Manager and help to drive continuous improvement in testing processes and procedures.
* Thorough adherence and follow\-up of VERTIV SECURE requirements and Vulnerability Management and Incident Response processes.
* Preference given to other practical skills such as functional analysis, memory image capture, static memory analysis, and data element extraction, etc.


 Job Requirements
   

  

* A bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science or related Engineering field is highly desirable.
* Additional advanced security qualifications such as CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification, Offensive Security Web Expert (OSWE) or equivalent preferred.
* Three or more years’ experience in information, application, and embedded product security and/or IT risk management with a focus on security, performance, and reliability
* Solid understanding of security protocols, cryptography, authentication, authorization, and security
* Good working knowledge of current IT risks and experience implementing security solutions
* Ability to interact with a broad cross\-section of personnel to articulate and enforce security measures
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills as well as business acumen
* Strong leadership, vision, effective communication and goal\-oriented
* Strong ability to establish partnerships and influence change and achieve results within dynamic environment
* Meaningful technical contributions into the development lifecycle of an application, product, or service


**Preferred Knowledge Experience Includes**
* Understanding and development experience of embedded systems / software, and web\-based applications
* Linux network device driver/data\-path performance exposure
* Familiarity with compilers, debuggers, disassemblers, and other low\-level development and analysis tools
* Exposure to binary analysis tools such as IDA Pro, WinDbg, BinWalk, Valgrind, PIN, Panda, and S2E
* Working knowledge of hacking tools and techniques such as memory corruption exploits, rootkits, protocol poisoning, browser\-based attacks, DNS poisoning, MetaSploit, nmap, Nessus, etc.
* Experience with UNIX kernel internals and low\-level Windows internals
* Comfort with reading and understanding of x86 and/or ARM assembly
* Experience with program analysis techniques such as taint analysis, program slicing, symbolic execution, constraint solving, and dynamic instrumentation
* An understanding of common cryptographic algorithms and protocols including their weaknesses and attacks against them
* Ability to extract software/firmware from provided hardware
* Meaningful experience utilizing git (Github or gitlab)
* Understanding of network protocols and experience developing packet\-level programs
* Experience with common microcontroller programming tools and debugging interfaces

* Computer boot process including boot loaders
* Conducting security evaluation and threat assessments of embedded systems, mobile applications, web applications

description:

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Founder’s / CEO’s Office \& Special Projects**

· Track project milestones, follow up with internal teams and external stakeholders, and drive tasks to closure.

**3\. HR Operations \& Support**

· Coordinate with external HR consultants/agencies to source profiles for open roles.

· Schedule interviews, manage candidate communication and track hiring progress.

· Manage onboarding — offer letters, documentation, ID creation, policy orientation and induction support.

· Maintain employee records, leave registers, attendance and HR documentation.

· Assist in drafting HR policies, updating SOPs and ensuring consistent HR administration.

**4\. Accounting \& Compliance Support (transaction volume: low to very low — knowledge is good to have; training provided)**

· Raise and share client invoices and follow up for timely fee collection.

· Record routine accounting entries and support periodic bank reconciliations.

· Support monthly payroll, GST/TDS payments and return filings, with guidance.

· Coordinate with banks and auditors; provide data for statutory audits.

· Maintain accounting software (Tally or equivalent) and prepare basic MIS — receivables, payables and cash\-flow trackers.

· Keep organised files for financial transactions, agreements and statutory correspondence.

**(Essential)**

· **Pune\-based, on\-site —** open to Pune\-based candidates only. This is an on\-site role at Erandwane, Pune (no relocation support).

· **Computer\-literate —** proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and quick to learn business tools.

· **Organised \& detail\-oriented —** strong attention to detail, organisation and ownership across parallel tasks.

· **Trustworthy —** discretion and integrity when handling confidential financial, business and personnel information.

**Good to Have (Not Essential)**

· **Accounting knowledge —** working knowledge of accounting and related areas — Tally (or similar), GST, TDS and payroll/statutory basics.

· **Commerce background —** a background in Commerce, Accounting or Business Administration.

· **Founder’s\-office exposure —** prior experience supporting a founder’s/CEO’s office or in an EA\-plus / chief\-of\-staff capacity.

· **Audit / startup exposure —** exposure to statutory audits, or experience in a startup / small\-business / multi\-functional generalist setup.

· **Marketing support —** basic content\-writing and social\-media coordination for light marketing support.

**Core Competencies**

· Ownership and reliability across multiple, parallel workstreams.

· Comfort with ambiguity and a fast pace — turning open\-ended asks into clear outcomes.

· Fast learner who can switch between special projects, administration, HR and accounts support.

· High trustworthiness and discretion with sensitive business and personnel information.

· A proactive, problem\-solving and continuous\-improvement mindset.

**Why This Role**

· Direct, day\-to\-day exposure to the Founder’s / CEO’s Office and how the business is run.

· Broad ownership across operations, HR, special projects and accounts — rare this early in a career.

· A strong launchpad to grow into operations, finance or a chief\-of\-staff track.

**Location \& Work Setup**

On\-site at Erandwane, Pune (Pune\-based candidates only). Standard working hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM.

title: HR Executive
description:
RaK's Pallikkoodam subscribes to the 21st century learning principles and is a student\-centered, future\-focused, coeducational day school. Creativity and Critical thinking, combined with developing the strength of character is at the core of our programme. The school is also grounded in the 21st\-century educational principles.

For more information, please visit https://www.rakspallikkoodam.com

***DESCRIPTION***

We are seeking an experienced, empathetic, and highly organized **HR Executive** to carry out our human resources functions. Unlike a corporate environment, an international school thrives on a community\-centric culture where empathy, patience, and relationship\-building are just as important as policy enforcement.

In this role, you will handle the entire employee lifecycle—from attracting top\-tier global educators to handling complex payroll, compliance, and employee grievances. To succeed, you must be a champion of confidential data management, possess exceptional English communication skills, and understand the fluid, event\-driven calendar of an educational institution.

***KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:***

* **End\-to\-End Recruitment \& Onboarding:** Handle the full talent acquisition cycle for academic, administrative, and support staff. This includes sourcing international and local educators, conducting background and reference checks, managing visa/work permit processes, and designing welcoming orientation programs.
* **Policy Formulation \& Implementation:** Update and implement school HR policies, staff handbooks, and codes of conduct. Ensure all policies align with local labor laws, international educational standards, and child safeguarding protocols.
* **Payroll \& Benefits Administration:** Handle monthly payroll processing, tax deductions, social security, health insurance, and end\-of\-service benefits with zero margin for error.
* **PF \& ESI:** Deep understanding of statutory compliance regarding PF and ESI, with proven expertise in handling registrations, monthly contributions, and documentation directly through the official portals.
* **Employee Relations \& Grievance Handling:** Act as the primary point of contact for staff grievances, conflicts, and personal queries. Mediate issues with high emotional intelligence, escalate it to the respective Leads / HODs / HOS and ensuring fair resolutions while maintaining a harmonious school climate.
* **Data Management \& HRIS:** Maintain meticulous, up\-to\-date physical and digital employee records (contracts, performance reviews, credentials). Fully manage the school’s HRIS (Human Resources Information System) to ensure data accuracy and generate insightful HR reports.
* **Confidentiality \& Compliance:** Handle sensitive information—such as salary structures, legal disputes, performance issues, and medical records—with the utmost discretion and integrity.

***REQUIRED QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE:***

* **3 to 5 years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 2 years specifically within an international school setting is mandatory.** (Experience navigating expatriate teacher recruitment and visa regulations is highly preferred).

* **Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.**

* Hands\-on experience working with HRIS software and payroll systems.
* Exceptional organizational skills for maintaining foolproof soft and hard copy filing systems.

***CULTURAL FIT \& WORKING ATTRIBUTES:***

**Connect:** 

**About FunnelKit**

FunnelKit empowers small businesses, entrepreneurs, and WooCommerce stores with no\-code funnel building and marketing automation tools that drive profitable growth. We offer a powerful suite of performance\-focused products for checkout optimisation, automation, and CRM.

We believe selling digitally is a human right, and we are committed to making eCommerce success accessible to everyone. We go far by going together—standing by our customers at every step of their journey.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **Video Content Creator** who is confident on camera, has excellent communication skills, and enjoys creating engaging video content. This role is ideal for someone who loves presenting, teaching, and connecting with audiences through video.

As a Video Content Creator, you will become one of the faces of FunnelKit’s content ecosystem. You will create software tutorials, product demonstrations, YouTube educational videos, advertisements, Reels, and Shorts that educate, engage, and inspire our audience.

The ideal candidate combines the confidence of a content creator with the clarity of a product educator and can communicate complex topics in a simple and engaging way.

**Core Focus Areas**

**Focus Area**: What You'll Create

* **Software Tutorials**: Product walkthroughs, feature tutorials, how\-to videos
* **Product Demonstrations**: Feature showcases, product explainers, release videos
* **YouTube Content**: Educational and instructional videos
* **Short\-Form Content**: Reels, Shorts, social media content
* **Marketing Videos**: Promotional videos and advertisements
* **On\-Camera Presentations**: Talking\-head videos, announcements, and product updates

**Key Responsibilities**

**On\-Camera Content Creation**

* Record software tutorials, product walkthroughs, and educational videos for YouTube.
* Create engaging on\-camera content for Reels, Shorts, and social media platforms.
* Present FunnelKit products and features in a professional, clear, and engaging manner.
* Record promotional videos, advertisements, and feature announcements.
* Deliver content confidently while maintaining a strong on\-camera presence.

**Product Education \& Communication**

* Explain software features, workflows, and concepts in a simple and easy\-to\-understand manner.
* Record screen\-sharing tutorials while clearly explaining product functionality.
* Help users understand how FunnelKit products solve real business problems.
* Ensure accuracy and clarity in all educational content.

**Content Collaboration**

* Collaborate with content writers, marketers, video editors, and product teams.
* Understand scripts, talking points, and content objectives before recording.
* Contribute ideas for video topics, content formats, and creative improvements.
* Record multiple takes when required to achieve the best delivery and presentation quality.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Stay updated with content creation trends, YouTube best practices, and video presentation techniques.
* Continuously improve communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.
* Learn about FunnelKit products and the WooCommerce ecosystem to become a trusted product educator.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong confidence and comfort appearing on camera regularly.
* Clear communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to explain software products and concepts in a simple and engaging way.
* Comfortable recording screen\-sharing tutorials while speaking.
* Good camera presence, energy, and personality.
* Ability to take feedback positively and continuously improve.
* Portfolio or previous content samples demonstrating communication or presentation skills.
* A 1–2 minute introduction video showcasing your communication and presentation abilities.
* Must have access to a good\-quality camera setup (a camera or a modern smartphone capable of recording high\-quality video).
* Must have a professional\-looking recording environment with good lighting, clean framing, and a suitable background for business and educational content.
* Must have a reliable internet connection and the ability to record high\-quality audio and video from home.
* Comfortable setting up and managing their own recording equipment and shooting environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience creating YouTube videos, tutorials, Reels, Shorts, podcasts, or educational content.
* Familiarity with WooCommerce, WordPress, SaaS products, or eCommerce tools.
* Experience presenting, teaching, public speaking, or creating content online.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms.
* Basic understanding of content creation workflows and social media platforms.

**Recording Setup Requirements**

To be successful in this role, candidates should have access to:

* A high\-quality smartphone camera or dedicated camera capable of recording professional\-looking videos.
* A clean, professional, and distraction\-free recording background.
* Good lighting setup (natural light or artificial lighting).
* Clear audio recording equipment (external microphone preferred).
* Stable internet connection for collaboration and file sharing.
* Ability to record screen tutorials and on\-camera videos independently from home.

**Personal Attributes**

* **Confident Communicator**: You are comfortable speaking on camera and communicating ideas clearly to different audiences.
* **Natural Educator**: You enjoy teaching and helping people understand new concepts and tools.
* **Product\-Focused Mindset**: You can learn product features quickly and explain them in a relatable and engaging way.
* **Creative Storyteller**: You know how to keep viewers engaged while delivering valuable information.
* **Camera\-Friendly Personality**: You bring energy, confidence, and authenticity to every recording.
* **Fast Learner:** You are curious, adaptable, and eager to improve your skills.
* **Team Player**: You enjoy collaborating with content creators, marketers, product managers, and editors.

**What You'll Love About Working Here**

* **Become the Face of a Growing Brand**: Help educate and inspire thousands of WooCommerce store owners and entrepreneurs worldwide.
* **Learn \& Grow**: Develop expertise in content creation, communication, public presentation, and product marketing.
* **Creative Freedom**: Contribute ideas and help shape FunnelKit’s content strategy and video presence.
* **Collaborative Environment**: Work closely with content creators, marketers, editors, and product teams in a supportive environment.
* **Career Development**: Build valuable skills in content creation, product communication, digital marketing, and personal branding.

**Our Commitment to You**

We are committed to providing the tools, guidance, and support you need to grow as a content creator. At FunnelKit, we believe in continuous learning, innovation, and helping our team members build meaningful careers while creating content that makes an impact.

**How to Apply**

Please share your CV, portfolio, previous content samples, and a 1–2 minute introduction video recorded using your current recording setup.

This helps us evaluate your communication skills, camera presence, audio quality, lighting, and overall presentation.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short video recording assignment as part of the selection process.
